      business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_netsuite2__tran_with_converted_amounts. - Inner join intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_lines on both transaction_id and transaction_line_id to bring line-level attributes. - Left join dimensions: - Accounts by account_id. - Accounting periods (as reporting_accounting_periods) by reporting_accounting_period_id. - Subsidiaries by subsidiary_id, then currencies by subsidiaries.currency_id to get the subsidiary currency symbol. - Classes by class_id, locations by location_id, and departments by department_id from the transaction line. - Keep only rows where is_income_statement is true and the transaction accounting period equals the reporting accounting period. - Select identifiers and attributes from the joined tables, including reporting period, account, subsidiary, class, location, department, and account_category. - Derivations: - account_number_and_name: join account_number and account_name with a single "-" (no spaces); if either input is NULL, the result is NULL. - income_statement_sort_helper: map the lowercase account_type_name as income→1, cogs→2, expense→3, othincome→4, othexpense→5; otherwise NULL. - converted_amount: negate converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period; transaction_amount: negate unconverted_amount; NULLs propagate. - Surrogate key income_statement_id: MD5 of transaction_line_id, transaction_id, accounting_period_id, and account_name joined by underscores; if any component is NULL, the key is NULL. - No aggregation or de-duplication is performed; duplicates from sources are preserved.'
      columns:

      - name: account_type_name

      - name: subsidiary_name

      - name: subsidiary_currency_symbol

      - name: account_number_and_name

      - name: class_id

        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Full class name from staging.stg_netsuite2__classes
      - name: location_id

      business_logic: '- Load all rows from staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines; no filtering or de-duplication. - Assign a sequential number tl_row to each transaction line starting at 1; ordering is undefined without an explicit sort. - From staging.stg_netsuite2__accounts, assign a sequential number account_row to each account starting at 1; let total_accounts be the count of accounts. - Requires total_accounts ≥ 1; if 0, the modulus-based selection causes the query to fail (division by zero). - For each transaction line, select exactly one account by cycling through accounts in sequence: line 1 -> account 1, line 2 -> account 2, …, line N -> account N, then wrap back to account 1 and repeat. The assignment depends on the undefined ordering of both sequences. - Derivations: - exchange_rate: fixed at 1.0. - amount: equal to netamount. - credit_amount: 0 when netamount is positive; otherwise the absolute value of netamount; becomes NULL when netamount is NULL. - debit_amount: netamount when netamount is positive; otherwise 0; becomes 0 when netamount is NULL. - paid_amount: fixed at 0. - unpaid_amount: fixed at 0. - is_posting: fixed TRUE. - Output all original transaction line fields plus the computed fields above.'

    - name: int_netsuite2__cash_flow_analysis
      description: Monthly cash flow by subsidiary with classification, trends, ratios, and forecasts for the last 24 months
      grain: One row per subsidiary_id per analysis_month
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_details
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transactions
      business_logic: 'Build monthly cash flow per subsidiary from detailed transactions, classify flows, compute trends, and add forecasts: - Start from transaction details joined to transactions on transaction_id; include only account types Bank, AcctRec, AcctPay, CredCard, OthCurrAsset, OthCurrLiab. - Derive analysis_month as the month bucket of accounting_period_ending. - Classify each line: - cash_flow_category: - Operating when account_type is Bank with transaction types CustInvc, CustPymt, VendBill, VendPymt, Check, Deposit; or when account_type is AcctRec or AcctPay. - Investing when account_type is Bank and the memo mentions equipment, asset, or investment (case-insensitive), or when transaction type is PurchOrd; NULL memos do not match. - Financing when account_type is Bank and the memo mentions loan, equity, or dividend (case-insensitive); NULL memos do not match. - Otherwise Operating. - cash_flow_direction: - Cash Inflow if account_type is Bank and amount > 0. - Cash Outflow if account_type is Bank and amount < 0. - Future Cash Inflow if account_type is AcctRec and amount > 0. - Future Cash Outflow if account_type is AcctPay and amount < 0. - Otherwise Non-Cash. - actual_cash_impact equals the amount only for Bank accounts; otherwise 0. - expected_cash_impact equals the amount for Bank, AcctRec, and AcctPay; otherwise 0. - Aggregate per subsidiary_id and analysis_month: - operating/investing/financing_cash_flow: sum actual_cash_impact for lines in that category (zero values have no effect). - net_cash_flow: sum actual_cash_impact across all lines (only Bank accounts contribute). - total_cash_inflows: sum actual_cash_impact where direction is Cash Inflow (non-negative). - total_cash_outflows: sum actual_cash_impact where direction is Cash Outflow (non-positive). - expected_operating_cash_flow: sum expected_cash_impact where category is Operating (includes Bank, AcctRec, AcctPay). - transaction_count: distinct transaction_id count; inflow_transactions: distinct transaction_id with actual_cash_impact > 0; outflow_transactions: distinct transaction_id with actual_cash_impact < 0. - Compute trends per subsidiary ordered by analysis_month: - Previous-month net and operating cash flow via lagged values. - cumulative_cash_flow and cumulative_operating_cash_flow as running totals up to the current month. - three_month_avg_cash_flow and three_month_avg_operating_cash_flow as moving averages over the current and prior two months (use available months when fewer than three exist). - net_cash_flow_change_rate = (current net minus previous net) divided by the absolute previous net when the previous net is nonzero; otherwise NULL. - operating_cash_flow_change_rate computed similarly for operating. - cash_flow_health: Excellent when operating > 0 and net > 0; Good when operating > 0 and net <= 0; Concerning when operating <= 0 and net > 0; otherwise Poor. - cash_flow_stability: Stable when the absolute deviation of net from its three-month average is within 20% of the absolute average; Moderate Volatility when within 50%; otherwise High Volatility. - cash_efficiency_ratio: total_cash_inflows divided by the absolute total_cash_outflows when outflows are nonzero; otherwise NULL. - analysis_date set to the current date at query runtime. - Forecast per subsidiary_id and analysis_month: - predicted_next_month_cash_flow equals the three-month average of net cash flow. - predicted_next_quarter_cash_flow equals net_cash_flow scaled by (1 + net_cash_flow_change_rate) and multiplied by 3 when the rate is present; otherwise three_month_avg_cash_flow multiplied by 3. - cash_flow_risk_level: - High Risk - Negative Trend when both cumulative_cash_flow and net_cash_flow are negative. - Medium Risk - Recovering when cumulative_cash_flow is negative and net_cash_flow is nonnegative. - Medium Risk - Declining when cumulative_cash_flow is nonnegative and net_cash_flow is negative. - Otherwise Low Risk - Positive Trend. - recommended_action: - Urgent: Review Operations & Financing when both operating_cash_flow and net_cash_flow are negative. - Review Operational Efficiency when operating_cash_flow is negative. - Consider Financing Options when net_cash_flow and financing_cash_flow are both negative. - Optimize Cash Management when cash_efficiency_ratio is below 1.2. - Otherwise Monitor Current Performance. - Output is the analysis joined left to the forecast on subsidiary_id and analysis_month, filtered to analysis_month within the last 24 months, ordered by subsidiary_id ascending and analysis_month descending, with a stable hash ID derived from subsidiary_id and analysis_month.'
      columns:
      - name: cash_flow_analysis_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique stable identifier hashed from subsidiary_id and analysis_month
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary identifier used to group and window all metrics
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: analysis_month
        data_type: DATE
        description: Month bucket derived from accounting_period_ending of transaction details
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: operating_cash_flow
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of actual cash impact for the Operating category; only Bank accounts contribute
      - name: investing_cash_flow
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of actual cash impact for the Investing category; only Bank accounts contribute
      - name: financing_cash_flow
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of actual cash impact for the Financing category; only Bank accounts contribute
      - name: net_cash_flow
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total actual cash impact across all lines (only Bank accounts)
      - name: total_cash_inflows
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of positive actual cash impacts labeled Cash Inflow; result is non-negative
      - name: total_cash_outflows
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of negative actual cash impacts labeled Cash Outflow; result is non-positive
      - name: expected_operating_cash_flow
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of expected cash impact for the Operating category (includes Bank, AcctRec, AcctPay)
      - name: cumulative_cash_flow
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cumulative net cash flow within subsidiary ordered by month up to the current month
      - name: cumulative_operating_cash_flow
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cumulative operating cash flow within subsidiary ordered by month up to the current month
      - name: three_month_avg_cash_flow
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average of net_cash_flow for the current and prior two months; early periods use available months
      - name: net_cash_flow_change_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Month-over-month change rate: (current net minus previous net) divided by the absolute previous net; NULL when previous net is zero or missing'
      - name: operating_cash_flow_change_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Month-over-month change rate: (current operating minus previous operating) divided by the absolute previous operating; NULL when previous operating is zero or missing'
      - name: cash_flow_health
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Label based on signs of operating and net cash flow: Excellent, Good, Concerning, or Poor'
      - name: cash_flow_stability
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Label by absolute deviation from the three-month average: Stable (≤20%), Moderate Volatility (≤50%), else High Volatility'
      - name: cash_efficiency_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Ratio of total_cash_inflows to the absolute total_cash_outflows when outflows are nonzero; otherwise NULL
      - name: predicted_next_month_cash_flow
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Forecast for next month equal to the three-month average of net cash flow
      - name: predicted_next_quarter_cash_flow
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Forecast for next quarter using the change rate when available; otherwise three times the three-month average
      - name: cash_flow_risk_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Risk label based on signs of cumulative and current net cash flow: High Risk - Negative Trend, Medium Risk - Recovering, Medium Risk - Declining, or Low Risk - Positive Trend'
      - name: recommended_action
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Action guidance driven by operating/net/financing results and efficiency ratio thresholds
      - name: transaction_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct transaction count per subsidiary and month after filtering eligible account types
      - name: inflow_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct transaction count with actual cash impact greater than zero
      - name: outflow_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct transaction count with actual cash impact less than zero
      - name: analysis_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Current date at query execution applied uniformly to all rows
        tests:
        - not_null
    - name: int_netsuite2__ar_aging_analysis
      description: Accounts receivable aging by customer and subsidiary with risk scoring and collection recommendations
      grain: One row per customer_id, subsidiary_id, customer_name, customer_email, customer_phone, and customer_credit_limit
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_details
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__entities
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__customers
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transactions
      business_logic: '- Build ar_transactions: - Join intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_details t to staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines tl on transaction_line_id. - Left join tl.entity_id to staging.stg_netsuite2__entities e, then to staging.stg_netsuite2__customers c via e.customer_id, and join t.transaction_id to staging.stg_netsuite2__transactions tr. - Filters: t.account_type_name in (''AcctRec'',''UnbilledRec''), t.converted_amount > 0, tl.entity_id not null. - Derive customer fields: customer_id = tl.entity_id; name/email/phone from c; credit_limit = c.receivables_account_id (text). - Derive dates: transaction_date from tr; due_date from tr. - days_past_due = days from due_date to today if due_date exists, else days from transaction_date to today; negative/zero means not past due. - calculated_due_date = due_date if present, else transaction_date plus 30 days. - Create ar_aging_buckets from ar_transactions: - aging_bucket by days_past_due: <=0 ''Current''; <=30 ''1-30 Days''; <=60 ''31-60 Days''; <=90 ''61-90 Days''; <=120 ''91-120 Days''; <=180 ''121-180 Days''; else ''Over 180 Days''. - expected_collection_rate by days_past_due: <=0 0.98; <=30 0.95; <=60 0.85; <=90 0.70; <=120 0.50; <=180 0.30; else 0.10. - Aggregate to customer_ar_summary (group by customer_id, customer_name, customer_email, customer_phone, customer_credit_limit, subsidiary_id): - total_ar_amount = sum(converted_amount); total_invoices = count of distinct transactions. - Bucket sums = sum(converted_amount) for each bucket; missing buckets contribute 0. - overdue_amount = sum(converted_amount) where days_past_due > 0. - overdue_percentage = overdue_amount / total_ar_amount if total_ar_amount > 0 else 0. - weighted_average_days_outstanding = sum(days_past_due weighted by converted_amount) divided by total_ar_amount if > 0 else 0. - expected_recoverable_amount = sum(converted_amount × expected_collection_rate); expected_loss_amount = sum(converted_amount × (1 − expected_collection_rate)). - earliest_due_date = minimum calculated_due_date; latest_due_date = maximum calculated_due_date; max_days_past_due = maximum days_past_due. - analysis_date = today’s date. - Compute customer_risk_assessment: - credit_utilization_ratio = total_ar_amount divided by numeric customer_credit_limit when the limit parses to a number > 0, else null. - customer_risk_score = min(100, overdue component (80 if overdue% ≥ 0.8 else overdue% × 100) plus WADO component (add 20 if ≥180; 15 if ≥90; 10 if ≥60; 5 if ≥30; else 0)). - collection_priority: Critical if total_ar_amount ≥ 10000 and overdue% ≥ 0.5; High if ≥ 5000 and ≥ 0.3; Medium if overdue% ≥ 0.2; Low if overdue_amount > 0; else Monitor. - recommended_action: Consider Write-off if overdue% ≥ 0.8 and max_days_past_due ≥ 180; Legal Action Required if ≥ 0.6 and ≥ 120; Urgent Follow-up if ≥ 0.4 and ≥ 90; Follow-up Required if ≥ 0.2 and ≥ 60; Gentle Reminder if ≥ 0.1; else No Action Required. - credit_status: if numeric credit limit exists and utilization ≥ 1.0 then Credit Limit Exceeded; else if numeric limit exists and utilization ≥ 0.8 then Approaching Credit Limit; else if overdue% ≥ 0.3 then Credit Hold Recommended; else Good Standing. - Add trend_analysis: - estimated_collection_days from WADO: ≤30 → 30; ≤60 → 45; ≤90 → 75; ≤120 → 100; else 150. - cash_flow_impact from overdue_amount: ≥10000 High Cash Flow Impact; ≥5000 Medium Cash Flow Impact; >0 Low Cash Flow Impact; else No Impact. - Final output: - Select all metrics; keep rows where total_ar_amount > 0. - ar_aging_id = MD5 of customer_id, subsidiary_id, and analysis_date joined with underscores. - Order rows by customer_risk_score descending, then total_ar_amount descending.'
      columns:
      - name: customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer identifier sourced from transaction line entity_id; not null due to join filter
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: customer_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer company name from customers; may be null if missing in source
      - name: customer_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer email from customers; may be null; no normalization applied
      - name: customer_phone
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer phone from customers; may be null; formatting preserved as-is
      - name: customer_credit_limit
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Receivables_account_id text from customers treated as credit limit only when it parses to a positive number
      - name: subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary identifier from transaction details; not null
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: total_ar_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of converted_amount for qualifying AR lines; strictly > 0 due to final filter; no rounding
      - name: overdue_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of converted_amount where days_past_due > 0; 0 if none; no rounding
      - name: expected_recoverable_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of converted_amount multiplied by the expected collection rate derived from days_past_due; no rounding
      - name: expected_loss_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of converted_amount multiplied by one minus the expected collection rate; no rounding
      - name: current_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of converted_amount for days_past_due ≤ 0 (Current bucket); 0 if none; no rounding
      - name: days_1_30_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of converted_amount for 1–30 days past due; 0 if none; no rounding
      - name: days_31_60_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of converted_amount for 31–60 days past due; 0 if none; no rounding
      - name: days_61_90_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of converted_amount for 61–90 days past due; 0 if none; no rounding
      - name: days_91_120_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of converted_amount for 91–120 days past due; 0 if none; no rounding
      - name: days_121_180_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of converted_amount for 121–180 days past due; 0 if none; no rounding
      - name: over_180_days_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of converted_amount for days_past_due > 180; 0 if none; no rounding
      - name: overdue_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Overdue_amount divided by total_ar_amount if total_ar_amount > 0 else 0; range 0–1; no rounding
      - name: credit_utilization_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: total_ar_amount divided by numeric customer_credit_limit when the limit parses to a number > 0; else null; may exceed 1.0; no rounding
      - name: weighted_average_days_outstanding
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Weighted average of days_past_due by converted_amount; returns 0 if total_ar_amount = 0; includes negative/zero values; no rounding
      - name: customer_risk_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Score capped at 100 combining overdue% (max 80 or overdue%×100) and WADO bonus (20/15/10/5/0 by thresholds); no rounding
      - name: collection_priority
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Priority based on total_ar_amount and overdue%: Critical, High, Medium, Low, or Monitor per thresholds'
      - name: recommended_action
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Consider Write-off, Legal Action Required, Urgent Follow-up, Follow-up Required, Gentle Reminder, or No Action Required based on overdue% and max_days_past_due thresholds
      - name: credit_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Credit Limit Exceeded or Approaching Credit Limit only when a numeric limit exists and utilization meets thresholds; else Credit Hold Recommended if overdue% ≥ 0.3, otherwise Good Standing
      - name: cash_flow_impact
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Categorized by overdue_amount: High Cash Flow Impact (≥10000), Medium Cash Flow Impact (≥5000), Low Cash Flow Impact (>0), or No Impact'
      - name: total_invoices
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of distinct transaction_id contributing to the customer’s AR within the subsidiary
      - name: max_days_past_due
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Maximum days_past_due across contributing transactions; can be negative/zero if all current; null only if all dates are missing
      - name: estimated_collection_days
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Estimated recovery days from WADO: ≤30→30; ≤60→45; ≤90→75; ≤120→100; else 150'
      - name: earliest_due_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest calculated_due_date (due_date or transaction_date plus 30 days); null if all source dates are null
      - name: latest_due_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Latest calculated_due_date (due_date or transaction_date plus 30 days); null if all source dates are null
      - name: analysis_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Date of analysis set to the current date for the run; not null
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: ar_aging_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: MD5 hash of customer_id, subsidiary_id, and analysis_date joined with underscores for row identity
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
    - name: int_netsuite2__acctxperiod_exchange_rate_map
      description: Account-by-period mapping to the applicable consolidated exchange rate for conversion to the primary (top-level) subsidiary
      grain: One row per account_id × accounting_period_id × from_subsidiary_id × to_subsidiary_id (duplicates possible)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounts
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__consolidated_exchange_rates
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__subsidiaries
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__currencies
      business_logic: '- Build period_exchange_rate_map from stg_netsuite2__consolidated_exchange_rates: - Join to stg_netsuite2__subsidiaries (as to_subsidiaries) on to_subsidiary_id to retrieve the subsidiary name and currency_id. - Join to stg_netsuite2__currencies on to_subsidiaries.currency_id to retrieve the currency symbol. - Keep only rows where to_subsidiary_id belongs to a subsidiary that has no parent (primary subsidiary). - Pass through accounting_period_id, from_subsidiary_id, to_subsidiary_id, and the three rate fields (average_rate, current_rate, historical_rate); no aggregation or sorting; duplicates are preserved. - Cross join every row in intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounts with every row in period_exchange_rate_map to form all account-by-period-by-subsidiary combinations. - For each combination, set exchange_rate based on accounts.general_rate_type using case-insensitive matching: - historical → use historical_rate - current → use current_rate - average → use average_rate - any other value or null → exchange_rate is null - Carry forward to_subsidiary_name and to_subsidiary_currency_symbol from the joined subsidiary and currency records. - No additional filtering, aggregation, or ordering is applied; source duplicates are retained.'
      columns:
      - name: accounting_period_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Accounting period identifier from consolidated exchange rates; pass-through with original casing; nulls preserved
      - name: from_subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Origin subsidiary ID for conversion; pass-through from consolidated exchange rates; original casing; nulls preserved
      - name: to_subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Target subsidiary ID restricted to primary subsidiaries; non-null due to the filter; duplicates preserved
      - name: to_subsidiary_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Name of the target primary subsidiary from subsidiaries; original casing and spacing; null if missing
      - name: to_subsidiary_currency_symbol
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Currency symbol of the target primary subsidiary from currencies via subsidiaries; original casing; null if currency or symbol is missing
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account identifier from accounts; cross-joined to all period exchange rate rows; pass-through with original casing; nulls preserved
      - name: exchange_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Selected rate per account based on general_rate_type (case-insensitive): historical uses historical_rate, current uses current_rate, average uses average_rate, otherwise null; no rounding or unit changes'
    - name: int_netsuite2__cash_flow_forecasting
      description: 12-month cash flow forecast per subsidiary using the last 36 months of analysis, with trend and seasonal adjustments and risk/action signals
      grain: One row per subsidiary_id per forecast_month
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__cash_flow_analysis
      business_logic: '- History window: use the last 36 months of analysis data per subsidiary. - Aggregate historical trends per subsidiary: - Averages: monthly net, operating, investing, and financing cash flows (NULLs are skipped). - Volatility: standard deviation of monthly net and operating cash flows (NULLs are skipped). - Trend deltas: for net and operating cash flow, compute the difference between the average of the most recent six months and the average of earlier months when at least 12 months exist; otherwise set to 0. - Quarterly seasonality: average monthly net cash flow per calendar quarter (Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4). - Latest period: most recent analysis_month; historical_periods: count of months used. - Seasonal factors per quarter: - For each quarter, divide the quarter’s average net cash flow by the overall average; if the overall average is zero or missing, or the quarter average is missing, use 1. - Forecast generation: - Only subsidiaries with historical_periods >= 6 are forecasted. - Create 12 future offsets (1 to 12 months). - For each offset, forecast_month = latest_period plus the offset in months. - Choose the seasonal factor based on the forecast_month’s calendar quarter (Q1: Jan–Mar, Q2: Apr–Jun, Q3: Jul–Sep, Q4: Oct–Dec). - Forecast calculations per subsidiary and offset: - Net: (average net cash flow + net trend scaled by offset/6) × seasonal factor. - Operating: (average operating cash flow + operating trend scaled by offset/6) × seasonal factor. - Investing: average investing cash flow × seasonal factor. - Financing: average financing cash flow × seasonal factor. - 95% bounds: lower = forecast net − 1.96 × net volatility; upper = forecast net + 1.96 × net volatility (results are NULL when volatility is NULL). - Confidence: - High: historical_periods >= 24 and net volatility <= 30% of the absolute average net. - Medium: historical_periods >= 12 and net volatility <= 50% of the absolute average net. - Low: historical_periods >= 6. - Very Low: otherwise. - Horizon: Short-term for offsets 1–3, Medium-term for 4–6, Long-term for 7–12. - Windowed metrics within each subsidiary ordered by offset: - Cumulative forecast cash flow: running sum of net forecasts up to the current offset (skips NULLs; returns NULL if the entire window has only NULLs). - Cumulative forecast operating cash flow: running sum of operating forecasts up to the current offset (skips NULLs; returns NULL if the entire window has only NULLs). - Three-month forecast average: average of net forecasts over the current and two prior offsets (skips NULLs; returns NULL when the frame contains only NULLs; may be based on fewer than three rows at the start). - Trend, risk, actions, and dates: - Trend: compare the current net forecast to the prior month’s net forecast within the subsidiary; classify as Positive Trend (both positive), Negative Trend (both negative), Improving (current positive, prior negative), Deteriorating (current negative, prior positive), else Stable (including when the prior is missing). - Risk level: - High Risk: current net forecast < 0 and cumulative net forecast < 0. - Medium Risk: current net forecast < 0 or cumulative net forecast < 0. - Low Risk: lower bound < 0. - Minimal Risk: otherwise. - Recommended action: - Critical: Immediate Cash Management Required when current net forecast < 0 and cumulative net forecast < −2 × absolute operating forecast. - Urgent: Review Short-term Liquidity when current net forecast < 0 and horizon is Short-term. - Consider Financing Options when cumulative net forecast < 0. - Monitor Cash Flow Closely when lower bound < 0. - Continue Current Strategy otherwise. - forecast_date is set to the current date at execution. - Output and ordering: - Return the selected fields and sort by subsidiary_id, then forecast_month_offset. - Create a deterministic ID by hashing the concatenation of subsidiary_id, an underscore, and the string form of forecast_month.'
      columns:
      - name: subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary identifier and grouping key; exactly one row per subsidiary_id and forecast_month
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: forecast_month
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Latest historical analysis_month plus forecast_month_offset months
      - name: forecast_month_offset
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Offset in months from the latest_period, generated as 1–12, used for window ordering and trend scaling
      - name: forecast_horizon
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Short-term for offsets 1–3, Medium-term for 4–6, Long-term for 7–12
      - name: forecast_net_cash_flow
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Projected net cash flow using average plus offset-scaled trend, multiplied by the seasonal factor; no rounding
      - name: forecast_operating_cash_flow
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Projected operating cash flow using average plus offset-scaled trend, multiplied by the seasonal factor; no rounding
      - name: forecast_investing_cash_flow
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Projected investing cash flow as average multiplied by the seasonal factor; no rounding
      - name: forecast_financing_cash_flow
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Projected financing cash flow as average multiplied by the seasonal factor; no rounding
      - name: forecast_net_cash_flow_lower_bound
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Lower 95% bound equals forecast net minus 1.96 times net volatility; NULL when volatility is NULL
      - name: forecast_net_cash_flow_upper_bound
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Upper 95% bound equals forecast net plus 1.96 times net volatility; NULL when volatility is NULL
      - name: forecast_confidence
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Confidence label based on historical_periods and net volatility relative to the absolute average net; NULL comparisons do not match and fall through
      - name: cumulative_forecast_cash_flow
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Running sum of forecast_net_cash_flow within subsidiary ordered by offset; skips NULLs and returns NULL when the window contains only NULLs
      - name: cumulative_forecast_operating_cash_flow
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Running sum of forecast_operating_cash_flow within subsidiary ordered by offset; skips NULLs and returns NULL when the window contains only NULLs
      - name: three_month_forecast_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Moving average of forecast_net_cash_flow over the current and two prior offsets; skips NULLs and returns NULL when the frame contains only NULLs
      - name: forecast_trend
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Trend classification based on current versus prior net forecast by subsidiary ordered by offset: Positive Trend, Negative Trend, Improving, Deteriorating, else Stable when no rule matches or the prior is missing'
      - name: forecast_risk_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Risk level based on net and cumulative net forecasts and the lower bound with precedence: High, Medium, Low, Minimal; NULL comparisons fall through'
      - name: recommended_action
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Action recommendation with precedence: Critical, Urgent, Consider Financing Options, Monitor Cash Flow Closely, else Continue Current Strategy'
      - name: net_cash_flow_volatility
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Historical net cash flow volatility (standard deviation over the last 36 months per subsidiary; NULLs are skipped)
      - name: historical_periods
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of historical months used (last 36 months); only subsidiaries with at least 6 months are forecasted
      - name: forecast_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Current date at execution when the forecast was generated
      - name: cash_flow_forecast_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Deterministic ID created by hashing subsidiary_id, an underscore, and the string form of forecast_month
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
    - name: int_netsuite2__customer_credit_risk
      description: Customer credit risk assessment from transaction details and lines with receivables metrics, behavior scores, activity status, and recommendations.
      grain: One row per customer_id and subsidiary_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_details
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      business_logic: '- Join transaction details to transaction lines on transaction_line_id; keep rows where entity_id is present and account_type_name is one of Accounts Receivable, AcctRec, Income, or Bank. - Derive per row: customer_id from entity_id; customer_name as "Customer_" plus the first 8 characters of customer_id; customer_email as "customer_" plus the first 8 characters and "@client.com"; customer_creation_date set to 365 days before today; customer_relationship_days fixed at 365. - Classify transaction_category: Receivable for Accounts Receivable/AcctRec, Revenue for Income, Payment for Bank, else Other. Set collection_status: Collected for Bank, Outstanding for Accounts Receivable/AcctRec, Billed for Income, else Other. - Aggregate by customer_id, customer_name, customer_email, customer_creation_date, customer_relationship_days, subsidiary_id: - total_receivables: sum of the absolute converted_amount for Receivable transactions. - total_collections: sum of the absolute converted_amount for Payment transactions. - total_revenue: sum of the absolute converted_amount for Revenue transactions. - outstanding_receivables: sum of the absolute converted_amount where collection_status is Outstanding. - total_transactions: count of unique transaction_ids. - payment_transactions: count of rows where transaction_category is Payment. - outstanding_transactions: count of rows where collection_status is Outstanding. - first_transaction_date: earliest accounting_period_ending; last_transaction_date: latest accounting_period_ending. - last_outstanding_date: latest accounting_period_ending among Outstanding; last_payment_date: latest accounting_period_ending among Payment. - Compute metrics: - collection_ratio: total_collections divided by total_receivables when total_receivables > 0, else 0. - avg_collection_delay_days: simulated delay of 30–89 days based on a deterministic hash of customer_id when there are payment transactions, else NULL. - relationship_duration_months: months between first and last transaction plus one when both exist, else 1. - customer_activity_status: Active if last transaction is within 30 days, Recent if within 90, Dormant if within 180, else Inactive. - days_since_last_outstanding: days from last_outstanding_date to today when present, else 0. - receivables_to_revenue_ratio: outstanding_receivables divided by total_revenue when total_revenue > 0, else 0. - Scoring (1–5): - payment_performance_score by collection_ratio: >=0.95→5, >=0.85→4, >=0.75→3, >=0.60→2, else 1. - payment_timeliness_score by avg_collection_delay_days: <=35→5, <=45→4, <=60→3, <=75→2, else 1 (NULL yields 1). - relationship_stability_score by relationship_duration_months: >=24→5, >=12→4, >=6→3, >=3→2, else 1. - revenue_volume_score by total_revenue: >=100000→5, >=50000→4, >=25000→3, >=10000→2, else 1. - receivables_control_score by receivables_to_revenue_ratio: <=0.10→5, <=0.20→4, <=0.30→3, <=0.40→2, else 1. - Final outputs: - total_credit_score: sum of the five component scores. - credit_rating by total_credit_score: >=20→AAA, >=16→AA, >=12→A, >=8→BBB, else BB. - risk_level: High Risk if outstanding_receivables > 40% of revenue and days_since_last_outstanding > 90; Medium Risk if >30% and >60 days; Low Risk if >20% and >45 days; else Minimal Risk. - recommended_credit_limit: revenue multiplied by 0.5/0.4/0.3/0.2/0.1 according to the same score bands as credit_rating. - collection_difficulty: Very Difficult if days_since_last_outstanding > 90 and collection_ratio < 0.7; Difficult if >60 and <0.8; Moderate if >30 and <0.9; else Easy. - risk_assessment_date: today’s date; customer_risk_id: deterministic hash of "customer_id_subsidiary_id" (NULL if subsidiary_id is missing). - Return rows where customer_id is present and total_revenue > 0.'
      columns:
      - name: customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer identifier from transaction lines; non-null.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: customer_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Synthetic name: ''Customer_'' plus the first 8 characters of customer_id.'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: customer_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Synthetic email: ''customer_'' plus the first 8 characters of customer_id and ''@client.com''.'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: customer_creation_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Set to 365 days before today.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: customer_relationship_days
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Fixed at 365 days.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: relationship_duration_months
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Months spanned by the first to last transaction plus one; defaults to 1 if either date is missing.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary identifier from transaction details; may be null.
      - name: total_receivables
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of absolute converted_amount for Receivable transactions; always populated.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: total_collections
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of absolute converted_amount for Payment transactions; always populated.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: total_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of absolute converted_amount for Revenue transactions; filtered to be greater than zero.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: outstanding_receivables
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of absolute converted_amount where collection_status is Outstanding; always populated.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: collection_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total collections divided by total receivables with zero when receivables are zero.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: receivables_to_revenue_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Outstanding receivables divided by total revenue with zero when revenue is zero; final rows have revenue > 0.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: avg_collection_delay_days
        data_type: UBIGINT
        description: Simulated 30–89 day delay based on a hash of customer_id when payment transactions exist; else NULL.
      - name: total_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of unique transaction_ids across all joined rows.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: payment_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of rows classified as Payment; zero if none.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: outstanding_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of rows with Outstanding status; zero if none.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: first_transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Earliest accounting_period_ending per customer_id and subsidiary_id.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: last_transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Latest accounting_period_ending per customer_id and subsidiary_id.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: last_payment_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Latest accounting_period_ending among Payment transactions; may be null.
      - name: last_outstanding_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Latest accounting_period_ending among Outstanding transactions; may be null.
      - name: days_since_last_outstanding
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days from last_outstanding_date to today; zero when last_outstanding_date is missing.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: payment_performance_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Score 1–5 by collection_ratio: >=0.95→5, >=0.85→4, >=0.75→3, >=0.60→2, else 1.'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: payment_timeliness_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Score 1–5 by avg_collection_delay_days: <=35→5, <=45→4, <=60→3, <=75→2, else 1; NULL yields 1.'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: relationship_stability_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Score 1–5 by relationship_duration_months: >=24→5, >=12→4, >=6→3, >=3→2, else 1.'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: revenue_volume_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Score 1–5 by total_revenue: >=100000→5, >=50000→4, >=25000→3, >=10000→2, else 1.'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: receivables_control_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Score 1–5 by receivables_to_revenue_ratio: <=0.10→5, <=0.20→4, <=0.30→3, <=0.40→2, else 1.'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: total_credit_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Sum of the five component scores (range 5–25).
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: credit_rating
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Rating bucket from total_credit_score: AAA (>=20), AA (>=16), A (>=12), BBB (>=8), else BB.'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: risk_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: High Risk if outstanding_receivables > 40% of revenue and days_since_last_outstanding > 90; Medium if >30% and >60; Low if >20% and >45; else Minimal.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: customer_activity_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Active if last_transaction_date within 30 days, Recent within 90, Dormant within 180, else Inactive.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: recommended_credit_limit
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Recommendation equals total_revenue multiplied by 0.5/0.4/0.3/0.2/0.1 based on total_credit_score bands.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: collection_difficulty
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Very Difficult if days_since_last_outstanding > 90 and collection_ratio < 0.7; Difficult if >60 and <0.8; Moderate if >30 and <0.9; else Easy.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: risk_assessment_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Today’s date at evaluation time.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: customer_risk_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Deterministic hash of customer_id and subsidiary_id joined by an underscore; NULL if subsidiary_id is missing.
        tests:
        - unique
    - name: int_netsuite2__customers

    - name: int_netsuite2__data_quality_metrics
      description: Comprehensive NetSuite data quality outputs combining an overall assessment with detailed per-table statistics and referential integrity checks
      grain: One row per report entry (overall assessment, table statistics, or integrity check)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transactions
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__customers
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__entities
      business_logic: 'Compile intermediate checks and summarize into a final unioned report ordered by report_type and quality_grade (ascending): - source_table_stats (per source table snapshot with current time): - Transactions: total records; unique records by distinct transaction_id; counts of null transaction_id (null_primary_keys), null transaction_date (null_dates), null entity_id (null_subsidiaries), null status (null_status); earliest_date = minimum transaction_date; latest_date = maximum transaction_date. - Transaction lines: total records; unique records by distinct transaction_line_id; counts of null transaction_line_id (null_primary_keys), null transaction_id (null_foreign_keys), null entity_id twice for both null_accounts and null_amounts; earliest_transaction = minimum transaction_id; latest_transaction = maximum transaction_id. - Customers: total records; unique records by distinct customer_id; counts of null customer_id (null_primary_keys), null company_name (null_names), null email_address (null_emails), null date_first_order_at (null_creation_dates); unique_names = distinct company_name count; unique_emails = distinct email_address count. - referential_integrity_checks (three left-join checks; integrity percentages rounded to two decimals): - transaction_lines_to_transactions: base = transaction_lines; matched = joined transaction_ids; orphaned = base minus matched; integrity = matched/base × 100 (two decimals); timestamp = current time. - transaction_lines_to_entities: base = transaction_lines; matched = joined entity_ids; orphaned and integrity computed as above; timestamp = current time. - transactions_to_entities: base = transactions; matched = joined entity_ids; orphaned and integrity computed as above; timestamp = current time. - business_rule_validations (four rules; compliance percentages rounded to two decimals; timestamp = current time): - transaction_id_uniqueness: violations = total transactions minus distinct transaction_id; compliance = distinct/total × 100. - customer_id_uniqueness: violations = total customers minus distinct customer_id; compliance = distinct/total × 100. - future_transaction_dates: violations = transactions with date more than one day in the future; compliance = transactions with date not more than one day in the future divided by total × 100. - balanced_journal_entries: sum netamount per transaction_id; violations = distinct transactions with absolute total_amount greater than 0.01; compliance = distinct transactions with absolute total_amount at most 0.01 divided by total × 100. - data_completeness_analysis (customers_contact_info and transaction_lines_account_assignment) is computed but not used in final output. - overall_quality_summary (single row): - completeness_score = average across source_table_stats of: for transactions, 100 if (null_primary_keys + null_dates + null_subsidiaries) equals 0 else 70; for customers, 100 if (null_primary_keys + null_names) equals 0 else 70; otherwise (e.g., transaction_lines) 85. - consistency_score = average integrity_percentage across referential_integrity_checks. - accuracy_score = average compliance_percentage across business_rule_validations. - assessment_timestamp = current time. - Final output (UNION ALL): - Overall row (report_type = ''Data Quality Assessment''): - overall_quality_score = average of completeness, consistency, and accuracy scores, rounded to two decimals. - quality_grade: Excellent (>= 95), Good (>= 85), Fair (>= 70), Poor (>= 50), otherwise Critical. - primary_concern: first applicable—Data Completeness Issues if completeness_score < 80; else Referential Integrity Issues if consistency_score < 80; else Business Rule Violations if accuracy_score < 80; else No Major Issues. - recommended_action: Immediate Data Cleansing Required if overall_quality_score < 70; Regular Data Quality Monitoring Recommended if < 85; otherwise Maintain Current Data Quality Standards. - tables_assessed = number of source_table_stats rows; integrity_checks_performed = number of referential_integrity_checks rows; business_rules_validated = number of business_rule_validations rows. - quality_assessment_id = MD5 of the assessment_timestamp as text. - Table Statistics rows (one per source_table_stats row; report_type = ''Table Statistics''): - quality_grade = table_name. - primary_concern = "Records: {total_records}, Unique: {unique_records}, Null PKs: {null_primary_keys}". - recommended_action: - Transactions: "Date Range: {earliest_date} to {latest_date}". - Transaction lines: "Date Range: {earliest_transaction} to {latest_transaction}" (transaction_id values). - Customers: "Date Range: {unique_names} to {unique_emails}" (distinct counts occupying those positions). - If any concatenated component is null, the whole string is null. - metric columns not applicable are null; assessment_timestamp = check_timestamp; quality_assessment_id = MD5 of table_name concatenated with check_timestamp as text. - Integrity Checks rows (one per referential_integrity_checks row; report_type = ''Integrity Checks''): - overall_quality_score = integrity_percentage (two decimals). - quality_grade = check_name. - primary_concern = "Matched: {matched}/{total}" using the matched join count over the base record count of the check. - recommended_action = "Orphaned Records: {orphaned_records}". - metric columns not applicable are null; assessment_timestamp = check_timestamp; quality_assessment_id = MD5 of check_name concatenated with check_timestamp as text. - Final ordering: by report_type then quality_grade ascending; casing and spacing in constructed strings are preserved.'
      columns:
      - name: report_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Row category: ''Data Quality Assessment'', ''Table Statistics'', or ''Integrity Checks'' (controls which metric columns are populated)'
        constraints:
        - not_null
      - name: completeness_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Overall completeness score from overall_quality_summary (unrounded average per rules); NULL for non-overall rows
      - name: consistency_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Overall consistency score as average of referential integrity percentages; NULL for non-overall rows
      - name: accuracy_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Overall accuracy score as average of business rule compliance percentages; NULL for non-overall rows
      - name: overall_quality_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Overall row: average of the three scores rounded to two decimals; Integrity rows: integrity percentage; Table Statistics: NULL'
      - name: quality_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Overall row: grade bucket (Excellent/Good/Fair/Poor/Critical); detail rows: table_name or check_name'
      - name: primary_concern
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Overall: dominant issue per precedence; Table Statistics: ''Records: X, Unique: Y, Null PKs: Z''; Integrity: ''Matched: matched/total'''
      - name: recommended_action
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Overall: action by thresholds; Table Statistics: date range or positional counts; Integrity: ''Orphaned Records: N'''
      - name: tables_assessed
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of source tables assessed (present only in overall row; NULL otherwise)
      - name: integrity_checks_performed
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of referential integrity checks performed (present only in overall row; NULL otherwise)
      - name: business_rules_validated
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of business rules validated (present only in overall row; NULL otherwise)
      - name: assessment_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Timestamp of the assessment or check snapshot based on current time
      - name: quality_assessment_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Row-unique MD5 identifier seeded by report-specific fields and timestamp (overall: timestamp; table stats: table_name+timestamp; integrity: check_name+timestamp)'
        constraints:
        - not_null
        - unique

      grain: One row per location; if multiple address rows match the main_address_id, one row per match; unmatched locations retain a single row with NULL address fields
