    - name: int_netsuite2__data_quality_metrics
      description: Comprehensive NetSuite data quality outputs combining an overall assessment with detailed per-table statistics and referential integrity checks
      grain: One row per report entry (overall assessment, table statistics, or integrity check)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transactions
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__customers
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__entities
      business_logic: 'Compile intermediate checks and summarize into a final unioned report ordered by report_type and quality_grade (ascending): - source_table_stats (per source table snapshot with current time): - Transactions: total records; unique records by distinct transaction_id; counts of null transaction_id (null_primary_keys), null transaction_date (null_dates), null entity_id (null_subsidiaries), null status (null_status); earliest_date = minimum transaction_date; latest_date = maximum transaction_date. - Transaction lines: total records; unique records by distinct transaction_line_id; counts of null transaction_line_id (null_primary_keys), null transaction_id (null_foreign_keys), null entity_id twice for both null_accounts and null_amounts; earliest_transaction = minimum transaction_id; latest_transaction = maximum transaction_id. - Customers: total records; unique records by distinct customer_id; counts of null customer_id (null_primary_keys), null company_name (null_names), null email_address (null_emails), null date_first_order_at (null_creation_dates); unique_names = distinct company_name count; unique_emails = distinct email_address count. - referential_integrity_checks (three left-join checks; integrity percentages rounded to two decimals): - transaction_lines_to_transactions: base = transaction_lines; matched = joined transaction_ids; orphaned = base minus matched; integrity = matched/base × 100 (two decimals); timestamp = current time. - transaction_lines_to_entities: base = transaction_lines; matched = joined entity_ids; orphaned and integrity computed as above; timestamp = current time. - transactions_to_entities: base = transactions; matched = joined entity_ids; orphaned and integrity computed as above; timestamp = current time. - business_rule_validations (four rules; compliance percentages rounded to two decimals; timestamp = current time): - transaction_id_uniqueness: violations = total transactions minus distinct transaction_id; compliance = distinct/total × 100. - customer_id_uniqueness: violations = total customers minus distinct customer_id; compliance = distinct/total × 100. - future_transaction_dates: violations = transactions with date more than one day in the future; compliance = transactions with date not more than one day in the future divided by total × 100. - balanced_journal_entries: sum netamount per transaction_id; violations = distinct transactions with absolute total_amount greater than 0.01; compliance = distinct transactions with absolute total_amount at most 0.01 divided by total × 100. - data_completeness_analysis (customers_contact_info and transaction_lines_account_assignment) is computed but not used in final output. - overall_quality_summary (single row): - completeness_score = average across source_table_stats of: for transactions, 100 if (null_primary_keys + null_dates + null_subsidiaries) equals 0 else 70; for customers, 100 if (null_primary_keys + null_names) equals 0 else 70; otherwise (e.g., transaction_lines) 85. - consistency_score = average integrity_percentage across referential_integrity_checks. - accuracy_score = average compliance_percentage across business_rule_validations. - assessment_timestamp = current time. - Final output (UNION ALL): - Overall row (report_type = ''Data Quality Assessment''): - overall_quality_score = average of completeness, consistency, and accuracy scores, rounded to two decimals. - quality_grade: Excellent (>= 95), Good (>= 85), Fair (>= 70), Poor (>= 50), otherwise Critical. - primary_concern: first applicable—Data Completeness Issues if completeness_score < 80; else Referential Integrity Issues if consistency_score < 80; else Business Rule Violations if accuracy_score < 80; else No Major Issues. - recommended_action: Immediate Data Cleansing Required if overall_quality_score < 70; Regular Data Quality Monitoring Recommended if < 85; otherwise Maintain Current Data Quality Standards. - tables_assessed = number of source_table_stats rows; integrity_checks_performed = number of referential_integrity_checks rows; business_rules_validated = number of business_rule_validations rows. - quality_assessment_id = MD5 of the assessment_timestamp as text. - Table Statistics rows (one per source_table_stats row; report_type = ''Table Statistics''): - quality_grade = table_name. - primary_concern = "Records: {total_records}, Unique: {unique_records}, Null PKs: {null_primary_keys}". - recommended_action: - Transactions: "Date Range: {earliest_date} to {latest_date}". - Transaction lines: "Date Range: {earliest_transaction} to {latest_transaction}" (transaction_id values). - Customers: "Date Range: {unique_names} to {unique_emails}" (distinct counts occupying those positions). - If any concatenated component is null, the whole string is null. - metric columns not applicable are null; assessment_timestamp = check_timestamp; quality_assessment_id = MD5 of table_name concatenated with check_timestamp as text. - Integrity Checks rows (one per referential_integrity_checks row; report_type = ''Integrity Checks''): - overall_quality_score = integrity_percentage (two decimals). - quality_grade = check_name. - primary_concern = "Matched: {matched}/{total}" using the matched join count over the base record count of the check. - recommended_action = "Orphaned Records: {orphaned_records}". - metric columns not applicable are null; assessment_timestamp = check_timestamp; quality_assessment_id = MD5 of check_name concatenated with check_timestamp as text. - Final ordering: by report_type then quality_grade ascending; casing and spacing in constructed strings are preserved.'
      columns:
      - name: report_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Row category: ''Data Quality Assessment'', ''Table Statistics'', or ''Integrity Checks'' (controls which metric columns are populated)'
        constraints:
        - not_null
      - name: completeness_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Overall completeness score from overall_quality_summary (unrounded average per rules); NULL for non-overall rows
      - name: consistency_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Overall consistency score as average of referential integrity percentages; NULL for non-overall rows
      - name: accuracy_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Overall accuracy score as average of business rule compliance percentages; NULL for non-overall rows
      - name: overall_quality_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Overall row: average of the three scores rounded to two decimals; Integrity rows: integrity percentage; Table Statistics: NULL'
      - name: quality_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Overall row: grade bucket (Excellent/Good/Fair/Poor/Critical); detail rows: table_name or check_name'
      - name: primary_concern
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Overall: dominant issue per precedence; Table Statistics: ''Records: X, Unique: Y, Null PKs: Z''; Integrity: ''Matched: matched/total'''
      - name: recommended_action
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Overall: action by thresholds; Table Statistics: date range or positional counts; Integrity: ''Orphaned Records: N'''
      - name: tables_assessed
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of source tables assessed (present only in overall row; NULL otherwise)
      - name: integrity_checks_performed
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of referential integrity checks performed (present only in overall row; NULL otherwise)
      - name: business_rules_validated
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of business rules validated (present only in overall row; NULL otherwise)
      - name: assessment_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Timestamp of the assessment or check snapshot based on current time
      - name: quality_assessment_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Row-unique MD5 identifier seeded by report-specific fields and timestamp (overall: timestamp; table stats: table_name+timestamp; integrity: check_name+timestamp)'
        constraints:
        - not_null
        - unique

    - name: int_netsuite2__supplier_credit_monitoring
      description: Supplier credit monitoring and risk assessment per vendor-subsidiary derived from Netsuite transaction details and lines
      grain: One row per (vendor_id, subsidiary_id) where vendor_id is not null and total_expenses > 0
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_details
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      business_logic: '1) Build vendor_transactions by joining transaction details to transaction lines on transaction_line_id; keep rows where entity_id is present and account_type_name is one of Accounts Payable, AcctPay, Expense, OthExpense, Bank. - Derive vendor fields deterministically from entity_id: vendor_id = entity_id; vendor_name = "Vendor_" + first 8 characters of vendor_id; vendor_email = "vendor_" + first 8 characters of vendor_id + "@supplier.com"; vendor_creation_date is 730 days before the run date; vendor_relationship_days = 730. - Classify transaction_category: Payable for Accounts Payable or AcctPay; Expense for Expense or OthExpense; Payment for Bank; otherwise Other. - Set payment_status: Paid for Bank; Outstanding for Accounts Payable or AcctPay; otherwise Other. 2) Aggregate vendor_payment_behavior grouped by vendor_id, vendor_name, vendor_email, vendor_creation_date, vendor_relationship_days, subsidiary_id: - total_payables: sum of absolute converted_amount for transactions classified as Payable; NULL amounts do not contribute. - total_payments: sum of absolute converted_amount for transactions classified as Payment; NULL amounts do not contribute. - total_expenses: sum of absolute converted_amount for transactions classified as Expense; NULL amounts do not contribute. - outstanding_balance: sum of absolute converted_amount for rows with payment_status Outstanding; NULL amounts do not contribute. - total_transactions: count of distinct transaction_id across all grouped rows. - payment_transactions: count of rows classified as Payment where transaction_id is present; not distinct. - outstanding_transactions: count of rows with payment_status Outstanding where transaction_id is present; not distinct. - first_transaction_date: earliest accounting_period_ending in the group. - last_transaction_date: latest accounting_period_ending in the group. - last_outstanding_date: latest accounting_period_ending among rows with payment_status Outstanding. - last_payment_date: latest accounting_period_ending among rows classified as Payment. 3) Compute vendor_risk_metrics: - payment_ratio: total_payments divided by total_payables when total_payables is positive; otherwise 0. - avg_payment_delay_days: if there is at least one payment transaction, set to 15 plus a deterministic offset from 0 to 29 based on vendor_id, yielding 15–44; otherwise NULL. - relationship_duration_months: number of calendar months between first and last transaction plus 1 when both exist; otherwise 1. - vendor_activity_status: Active if the last transaction is within 30 days of the run date; Recent if within 90; Dormant if within 180; otherwise Inactive; if last_transaction_date is NULL, treat as Inactive. - days_since_last_outstanding: days elapsed since last_outstanding_date; if it does not exist, set to 0. 4) Compute vendor_credit_scoring: - payment_performance_score: 5/4/3/2/1 for payment_ratio ≥0.95/≥0.85/≥0.75/≥0.60/else. - payment_timeliness_score: 5/4/3/2/1 for avg_payment_delay_days ≤20/≤30/≤40/≤50/else; NULL delay yields 1. - relationship_stability_score: 5/4/3/2/1 for relationship_duration_months ≥24/≥12/≥6/≥3/else. - transaction_frequency_score: 5/4/3/2/1 for total_transactions ≥50/≥25/≥10/≥5/else. 5) Final outputs: - total_credit_score: sum of the four component scores. - credit_rating: AAA/AA/A/BBB/BB for total_credit_score ≥16/≥13/≥10/≥7/else. - risk_level: High Risk if outstanding_balance exceeds 30% of total_expenses and days_since_last_outstanding >60; Medium Risk if exceeds 20% and >45; Low Risk if outstanding_balance >0 and >30; otherwise Minimal Risk (evaluated in this order). - recommended_credit_limit: total_expenses multiplied by 0.5/0.4/0.3/0.2/0.1 for total_credit_score ≥16/≥13/≥10/≥7/else. - monitoring_date: the run date. - supplier_monitoring_id: MD5 hash of vendor_id and subsidiary_id joined by an underscore. - Filter final rows to vendor_id present and total_expenses > 0.'
      columns:
      - name: vendor_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Vendor identifier from transaction_lines.entity_id; not null; grouping key with subsidiary_id
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: vendor_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Synthetic name 'Vendor_' + first 8 chars of vendor_id; deterministic per vendor_id
      - name: vendor_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Synthetic email 'vendor_' + first 8 chars of vendor_id + '@supplier.com'; deterministic per vendor_id
      - name: vendor_creation_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp 730 days before the run date; constant per run
      - name: vendor_relationship_days
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Fixed value 730 representing relationship age in days
      - name: relationship_duration_months
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Months between first and last transaction plus 1 when both exist; else 1
      - name: subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary identifier from transaction details; groups output with vendor_id
      - name: total_payables
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of absolute converted_amount for Payable transactions; NULL amounts excluded; no rounding
      - name: total_payments
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of absolute converted_amount for Payment transactions; NULL amounts excluded; no rounding
      - name: total_expenses
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of absolute converted_amount for Expense transactions; NULL amounts excluded; filtered to > 0
      - name: outstanding_balance
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of absolute converted_amount where payment_status is Outstanding; NULL amounts excluded
      - name: payment_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total_payments divided by total_payables when total_payables > 0; else 0
      - name: avg_payment_delay_days
        data_type: UBIGINT
        description: If payment_transactions > 0 then deterministic integer in 15–44 based on vendor_id; else NULL
      - name: total_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of distinct transaction_id across joined rows
      - name: payment_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of rows classified as Payment with non-NULL transaction_id; not distinct
      - name: outstanding_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of rows with payment_status Outstanding and non-NULL transaction_id; not distinct
      - name: first_transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Earliest accounting_period_ending per group
      - name: last_transaction_date

        description: Latest accounting_period_ending per group
      - name: last_payment_date

      - name: last_outstanding_date

      - name: days_since_last_outstanding

      - name: payment_performance_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Score 5/4/3/2/1 for payment_ratio thresholds ≥0.95/≥0.85/≥0.75/≥0.60/else
      - name: payment_timeliness_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Score 5/4/3/2/1 for avg_payment_delay_days thresholds ≤20/≤30/≤40/≤50/else; NULL yields 1
      - name: relationship_stability_score

        description: Score 5/4/3/2/1 for relationship_duration_months thresholds ≥24/≥12/≥6/≥3/else
      - name: transaction_frequency_score

      - name: total_credit_score

      - name: vendor_activity_status

    - name: int_netsuite2__tran_and_reporting_periods
      description: Identity mapping of accounting periods to reporting periods for mock data
      grain: One row per source accounting_periods row (no deduplication)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounting_periods
      business_logic: '- Read all rows from intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounting_periods (no filters, no joins). - For each input row, emit: - accounting_period_id = accounting_period_id from the source row. - reporting_accounting_period_id = the same accounting_period_id value (identity mapping). - No additional transformations: - Duplicates from the source are preserved; no DISTINCT or aggregation. - NULL values are preserved as-is. - No ordering is enforced.'
      columns:
      - name: accounting_period_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Accounting period identifier copied 1:1 from intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounting_periods; duplicates and NULLs are preserved
      - name: reporting_accounting_period_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reporting period identifier set equal to accounting_period_id for each row; duplicates and NULLs mirror the source accounting_period_id
    - name: int_netsuite2__tran_lines_w_accounting_period
      description: Transaction lines with a cyclically assigned accounting period and amount defaulted to 0 when NULL
      grain: One row per transaction line record from intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounting_periods
      business_logic: '- Read all rows from intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_lines and assign each a sequential position (tl_row) with no specified ordering. - Read all rows from intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounting_periods and assign each a sequential position (period_row) with no specified ordering. - Let N be the number of available accounting periods. If N = 0 the query fails because the period assignment requires a modulo calculation. - For each transaction line at position k, assign the accounting period whose position is the remainder of (k - 1) divided by N, plus one. This cycles through the period list repeatedly in its arbitrary order, assigning exactly one period to each line when N >= 1. - Output one row per transaction line: pass through transaction_id, transaction_line_id, subsidiary_id, and account_id unchanged; set transaction_accounting_period_id to the assigned period’s accounting_period_id; set unconverted_amount to 0 when the source line amount is NULL, otherwise use the original amount. No aggregation, filtering, rounding, or de-duplication is applied.'
      columns:
      - name: transaction_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier of the source transaction; passed through from transaction lines without transformation
      - name: transaction_line_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier of the transaction line; passed through from transaction lines without transformation
      - name: subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary identifier for the line; passed through from transaction lines; may be NULL
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account identifier for the line; passed through from transaction lines; may be NULL
      - name: transaction_accounting_period_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Accounting period id assigned by cycling through available periods based on the transaction line’s position; ordering is arbitrary due to unordered row numbering; may be NULL if the source period id is NULL
      - name: unconverted_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Line amount with NULLs defaulted to 0; no rounding or currency conversion applied
        tests:
        - not_null
    - name: int_netsuite2__tran_with_converted_amounts
      description: Transaction lines replicated by reporting period with pass-through amounts and account classifications.
      grain: One row per combination of transaction_line_id and reporting_accounting_period_id; if no mapping, reporting_accounting_period_id is NULL.
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__tran_lines_w_accounting_period
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__tran_and_reporting_periods
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounts
      business_logic: '- Start from all rows in intermediate.int_netsuite2__tran_lines_w_accounting_period. - Left join intermediate.int_netsuite2__tran_and_reporting_periods on transaction_accounting_period_id = accounting_period_id to add reporting_accounting_period_id; all transaction lines are retained, NULL is set when no mapping exists, and multiple rows can result if the mapping table has duplicates for a given accounting period. - Left join intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounts on account_id to classify accounts: * is_income_statement is TRUE when the account type (compared case-insensitively) is one of income, othincome, expense, othexpense, or cogs; otherwise FALSE, including when the type is missing. * account_category (case-insensitive type match): - Asset for acctrec, bank, deferexpense, fixedasset, othasset, othcurrasset, unbilledrec - Expense for cogs, expense, othexpense - Income for income, othincome - Liability for acctpay, credcard, deferrevenue, longtermliab, othcurrliab - Equity for equity, retained_earnings, net_income - Other for nonposting, stat - NULL when no type or no match. - Set converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period = unconverted_amount (no conversion; NULL propagates). - Set converted_amount_using_reporting_month = unconverted_amount (no conversion; NULL propagates). - Create tran_with_converted_amounts_id by MD5 hashing the concatenation of transaction_line_id, transaction_id, account_id, and reporting_accounting_period_id joined with "_" in that order; if any component is NULL, the concatenation and the id are NULL; component values are used as-is without trimming or case changes.'
      columns:
      - name: transaction_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Transaction identifier passed through from transaction lines.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: transaction_line_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Transaction line identifier used for row grain and surrogate key.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary identifier from transaction lines; NULLs are preserved.
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account identifier used to join to account attributes; NULLs are preserved.
      - name: transaction_accounting_period_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Accounting period of the transaction line used to map reporting periods; NULLs are preserved.
      - name: unconverted_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Original transaction amount in transaction currency; values are passed through; NULLs are preserved.
      - name: reporting_accounting_period_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reporting period derived from transaction_accounting_period_id; NULL if no mapping; duplicates possible if the mapping table has multiple rows per accounting period.
      - name: converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Equal to unconverted_amount with no exchange rate applied; NULL when unconverted_amount is NULL.
      - name: converted_amount_using_reporting_month
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Equal to unconverted_amount with no exchange rate applied; NULL when unconverted_amount is NULL.
      - name: is_income_statement
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: TRUE when account type is income, othincome, expense, othexpense, or cogs (case-insensitive); otherwise FALSE, including when type is missing.
      - name: account_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Category derived from account type (case-insensitive) per defined sets; NULL when unmatched or type is missing.
      - name: tran_with_converted_amounts_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: MD5 of transaction_line_id, transaction_id, account_id, and reporting_accounting_period_id concatenated with '_' in that order; NULL if any component is NULL.
    - name: int_netsuite__transaction_lines_w_accounting_period
      description: Transaction lines joined to the parent transaction’s accounting period; excludes revenue arrangements and non-posting lines.
      grain: One row per transaction_lines record that joins to a transaction and passes the filters
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_netsuite__transaction_lines
      - staging.stg_netsuite__transactions
      business_logic: '- Load all rows from staging.stg_netsuite__transaction_lines (transaction_lines) and staging.stg_netsuite__transactions (transactions). - Inner join on exact equality of transaction_id; transaction_lines without a matching transaction are excluded. - Apply filters using case-insensitive comparisons and no trimming: - Exclude rows where the transaction’s transaction_type equals "revenue arrangement"; NULL values are excluded by the filter. - Exclude rows where non_posting_line equals "yes" when interpreted as text; NULL values are excluded by the filter. - Project columns: - transaction_id, transaction_line_id, subsidiary_id, account_id from transaction_lines. - transaction_accounting_period_id from transactions.accounting_period_id. - unconverted_amount set to transaction_lines.amount when present, otherwise 0. - No aggregation, sorting, or de-duplication; duplicates from the source are preserved.'
      columns:
      - name: transaction_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        constraints:
        - not_null
        description: Transaction identifier from transaction_lines; must match a transaction to be included.
      - name: transaction_line_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Line identifier from transaction_lines; may be NULL and duplicates are preserved.
      - name: subsidiary_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Subsidiary associated with the line from transaction_lines; nullable pass-through.
      - name: account_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Account associated with the line from transaction_lines; nullable pass-through.
      - name: transaction_accounting_period_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Accounting period of the parent transaction from transactions.accounting_period_id; nullable pass-through.
      - name: unconverted_amount
        data_type: INTEGER
        constraints:
        - not_null
        description: Line amount without currency conversion from transaction_lines.amount; defaults to 0 when NULL; sign preserved; no aggregation or rounding.
    - name: int_netsuite__accountxperiod_exchange_rate_map
      description: Account-by-period exchange rate selection by subsidiary pair using primary accounting books and top-level target subsidiaries
      grain: One row per account_id per accounting_period_id per from_subsidiary_id per to_subsidiary_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_netsuite__accounts
      - staging.stg_netsuite__consolidated_exchange_rates
      - staging.stg_netsuite__subsidiaries
      - staging.stg_netsuite__accounting_books
      business_logic: '- From subsidiaries, keep only top-level subsidiaries (no parent). These define eligible to_subsidiary_id values. - From accounting_books, keep only primary books (is_primary equals "yes", case-insensitive). - From consolidated_exchange_rates, keep rows where to_subsidiary_id is top-level and accounting_book_id is primary. Retain accounting_period_id, from_subsidiary_id, to_subsidiary_id, average_rate, current_rate, historical_rate. - Cross join all accounts with the filtered exchange rate rows to produce every combination of account and (accounting_period_id, from_subsidiary_id, to_subsidiary_id). - For each combination, set exchange_rate based on accounts.general_rate_type (case-insensitive): - "historical" → use historical_rate - "current" → use current_rate - "average" → use average_rate - any other value or NULL → exchange_rate = NULL - Output columns: accounting_period_id, from_subsidiary_id, to_subsidiary_id, account_id, exchange_rate. No de-duplication, ordering, casting, or rounding is applied.'
      columns:
      - name: accounting_period_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Accounting period from the filtered consolidated exchange rates
      - name: from_subsidiary_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Source subsidiary from the filtered consolidated exchange rates
      - name: to_subsidiary_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Target subsidiary limited to top-level subsidiaries with no parent
      - name: account_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Account identifier; every account is cross-joined to each filtered period/subsidiary row
      - name: exchange_rate
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Selected rate value as text based on account.general_rate_type (historical/current/average, case-insensitive); NULL if type does not match or the chosen source rate is NULL
    - name: int_netsuite__transaction_and_reporting_periods
      description: Mapping of non-quarter, non-year base accounting periods to same-calendar reporting periods that start on/after the base and are not in the future.
      grain: One row per (accounting_period_id, reporting_accounting_period_id) pair
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_netsuite__accounting_periods
      - staging.stg_netsuite__subsidiaries
      business_logic: '- Load accounting_periods from staging.stg_netsuite__accounting_periods and subsidiaries from staging.stg_netsuite__subsidiaries. - Select base periods where: - quarter is false - year_0 is false - fiscal_calendar_id exists in subsidiaries (distinct fiscal_calendar_id). - For each base period, join to multiplier periods from the same accounting_periods table where: - fiscal_calendar_id matches the base - quarter matches the base (both false) - year_0 matches the base (both false) - starting_at of the multiplier is on or after the base starting_at (as stored in the source) - the multiplier''s starting_at, truncated to seconds and interpreted as a timestamp, is not later than the current time at evaluation. - Emit one row per qualifying pair: - accounting_period_id = base.accounting_period_id - reporting_accounting_period_id = multiplier.accounting_period_id - No ordering, aggregation, or de-duplication is applied; duplicates from source are preserved.'
      columns:
      - name: accounting_period_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Identifier of the base non-quarter, non-year accounting period in a subsidiary fiscal calendar; may appear in multiple rows paired with later or equal reporting periods.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: reporting_accounting_period_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Identifier of a non-quarter, non-year reporting period in the same fiscal calendar that starts on or after the base and is not in the future when evaluated.
        tests:
        - not_null
    - name: int_netsuite__transactions_with_converted_amounts
      description: Transaction lines enriched with reporting period, exchange rates for transaction and reporting periods, converted amounts, and account-based flags.
      grain: One row per transaction_line_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite__transaction_lines_w_accounting_period
      - intermediate.int_netsuite__transaction_and_reporting_periods
      - intermediate.int_netsuite__accountxperiod_exchange_rate_map
      - staging.stg_netsuite__accounts
      business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_netsuite__transaction_lines_w_accounting_period (one row per transaction line with transaction_id, transaction_line_id, subsidiary_id, account_id, transaction_accounting_period_id, unconverted_amount). - Inner join to intermediate.int_netsuite__transaction_and_reporting_periods on transaction_accounting_period_id to obtain reporting_accounting_period_id; rows without a match are excluded. - Inner join to intermediate.int_netsuite__accountxperiod_exchange_rate_map twice to attach exchange rates: - Reporting-period rate: match on reporting_accounting_period_id (as accounting period), account_id, and from_subsidiary_id = subsidiary_id; output as exchange_rate_reporting_period. - Transaction-period rate: match on transaction_accounting_period_id (as accounting period), account_id, and from_subsidiary_id = subsidiary_id; output as exchange_rate_transaction_period. - Both joins are required; rows missing either rate are excluded. - Compute converted amounts by multiplying unconverted_amount by the corresponding exchange rate after converting both to numeric; no rounding is applied, the sign is preserved, and the result is NULL if either input is NULL. - Left join staging.stg_netsuite__accounts on account_id to derive: - is_income_statement: TRUE when type_name (case-insensitive) is one of income, other income, expense, other expense, or cost of goods sold; otherwise FALSE (including NULL). - account_category from type_name (case-insensitive): Asset (accounts receivable, bank, deferred expense, fixed asset, other asset, other current asset, unbilled receivable, prepaid expense), Expense (cost of goods sold, expense, other expense), Income (income, other income), Liability (accounts payable, credit card, deferred revenue, long term liability, other current liability), Equity (equity, retained earnings, net income), Other (non posting, statistical); else NULL. - Output includes all base and derived fields; one row per transaction_line_id that meets the inner-join conditions.'
      columns:
      - name: transaction_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier of the parent transaction sourced from the base transaction line.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: transaction_line_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique transaction line identifier; the model outputs one row per transaction_line_id.
        tests:
        - not_null

      - name: subsidiary_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Subsidiary of the transaction line; used to match exchange rates via from_subsidiary_id.
      - name: account_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Account on the transaction line; used to match exchange rates and derive account-based flags.
      - name: transaction_accounting_period_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Accounting period of the transaction line; used to find the reporting period and transaction-period exchange rate.

        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Original line amount before conversion; if NULL, both converted amounts are NULL.
      - name: reporting_accounting_period_id

        description: Reporting period mapped from transaction_accounting_period_id via the period mapping table.
      - name: exchange_rate_reporting_period
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Exchange rate for the reporting period matched by reporting_accounting_period_id, account_id, and subsidiary; stored as text and used for conversion.
      - name: exchange_rate_transaction_period
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Exchange rate for the transaction accounting period matched by transaction_accounting_period_id, account_id, and subsidiary; stored as text and used for conversion.
      - name: converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Product of unconverted_amount and the transaction-period exchange rate after numeric conversion; no rounding; NULL if either input is NULL.
      - name: converted_amount_using_reporting_month
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Product of unconverted_amount and the reporting-period exchange rate after numeric conversion; no rounding; NULL if either input is NULL.
      - name: is_income_statement
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: TRUE when account type_name (case-insensitive) is income, other income, expense, other expense, or cost of goods sold; otherwise FALSE.
      - name: account_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Category derived from account type_name (case-insensitive) into Asset, Expense, Income, Liability, Equity, or Other; NULL if no match.
  marts_models:
    - name: netsuite2_customer_analytics
      description: Customer analytics derived from profitability (RFM-style), behavior patterns, retention scoring, and action recommendations
      grain: One row per customer_id (per build date = segmentation_date)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__customer_profitability
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_details
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      business_logic: 'Build a customer analytics view by combining profitability (cp), behavioral patterns (cbp), and retention (cr), then deriving insights and recommendations: - customer_behavior_patterns (cbp): - Join intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_details t to staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines tl on transaction_line_id. - Filter rows: tl.entity_id IS NOT NULL, t.account_type_name = ''Income'', t.converted_amount > 0. - Aggregate by tl.entity_id (as customer_id) and t.subsidiary_id: - Transaction frequency: total_transactions = distinct transaction_id count; active_months = distinct calendar months; active_quarters = distinct calendar quarters. - Amounts (Income only): total_revenue = sum of positive amounts; avg_transaction_value = mean of positive amounts (NULLs excluded); transaction_value_volatility = sample standard deviation of positive amounts (NULLs excluded); max/min as per positive Income amounts. - Timing: first_transaction_date = earliest accounting period end; last_transaction_date = latest accounting period end; customer_lifespan_days = days between first and last transaction. - Seasonal counts: q1/q2/q3/q4_transactions = distinct transaction counts by calendar quarter. - Recency: days_since_last_transaction = days between last transaction and today. - analysis_date = today. - customer_retention (cr) from cbp: - retention_category by customer_lifespan_days thresholds: ≥365 Long-term; ≥180 Medium-term; ≥90 Short-term; ≥30 New; else Very New. - activity_status by days_since_last_transaction: ≤30 Highly Active; ≤90 Active; ≤180 At Risk; ≤365 Dormant; else Lost. - avg_transactions_per_month = total_transactions divided by (customer_lifespan_days/30.0) when active_months > 0 and customer_lifespan_days > 0; otherwise 0; no rounding. - retention_probability: 0.95 if days≤30 and total_transactions≥5; 0.80 if days≤60 and total_transactions≥3; 0.60 if days≤90 and total_transactions≥2; 0.30 if days≤180; 0.10 if days≤365; else 0.05. - Carry through total_transactions, total_revenue, avg_transaction_value, days_since_last_transaction. - enhanced_customer_segmentation (ecs) by left joining cp to cr on customer_id: - Carry cp.customer_name, customer_email, subsidiary_id, profitability_segment (cp.customer_segment), total_revenue, net_profit, transaction_count, customer_age_days; avg_transactions_per_month and retention_probability from cr. - value_tier via overall revenue percentile thresholds across cp: ≥90th Platinum; ≥70th Gold; ≥50th Silver; ≥30th Bronze; else Basic (inclusive comparisons). - comprehensive_customer_score = weighted sum of cp revenue/frequency/margin scores plus activity and retention bonuses, capped at 100. - lifecycle_stage: Onboarding if customer_age_days≤90 and activity in (Highly Active, Active); Growth if customer_age_days≤365 and revenue above the overall cp average; Mature if retention in (Long-term, Medium-term) and activity in (Highly Active, Active); At Risk if activity = At Risk; Churned if activity in (Dormant, Lost); else Developing. - segmentation_date = today. - customer_insights by left joining ecs to cbp on customer_id: - Carry transaction_value_volatility and q1–q4_transactions from cbp. - seasonal_preference from the highest of q1..q4 counts: Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 Peak based on which count is the maximum; ties break by first match in order Q1→Q2→Q3→Q4; else No Clear Pattern. - transaction_consistency: if volatility is NULL or 0 then Single Transaction; else compare volatility to avg_transaction_value: ≤0.3x Very Consistent; ≤0.6x Consistent; ≤1.0x Moderate Variance; else High Variance. - growth_potential: High Growth Potential if lifecycle_stage=Onboarding and comprehensive_customer_score≥70; Expansion Ready if lifecycle_stage=Growth and value_tier in (Gold, Platinum); Loyalty Program Candidate if lifecycle_stage=Mature and activity_status=Highly Active; Recovery Priority if lifecycle_stage=At Risk and value_tier in (Silver, Gold, Platinum); else Standard Growth. - recommended_action (evaluated in order): if lifecycle_stage=Churned and value_tier in (Gold, Platinum) then Win-Back Campaign; else if lifecycle_stage=At Risk then Retention Campaign; else if lifecycle_stage=Onboarding then Onboarding Support; else if growth_potential=Expansion Ready then Upsell Opportunity; else if value_tier=Platinum and activity_status=Highly Active then VIP Treatment; else Regular Engagement. - engagement_frequency (first-match wins): Platinum Weekly; else Gold Bi-weekly; else Silver Monthly; else if lifecycle_stage=At Risk then Immediate; else Quarterly. - Final projection and filters: - Select the columns listed below from customer_insights. - Filter out rows where customer_id IS NULL and where cp.total_revenue ≤ 0. - Create customer_analytics_id as a deterministic hash of customer_id and segmentation_date joined by an underscore. - Sort descending by comprehensive_customer_score, then by total_revenue. - Result grain is one row per customer_id for the build date (segmentation_date).'
      columns:
      - name: customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer identifier sourced from cp (and cbp), filtered to NOT NULL in final output
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: customer_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer name from cp; propagated as-is without trimming or case normalization
      - name: customer_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer email from cp; propagated as-is without validation
      - name: subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary identifier from cp (behavioral CTE uses t.subsidiary_id but final value comes from cp)
      - name: profitability_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Profitability classification from cp.customer_segment carried through unchanged
      - name: value_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Revenue-based tier using overall percentile thresholds on cp.total_revenue: ≥P90 Platinum, ≥P70 Gold, ≥P50 Silver, ≥P30 Bronze, else Basic'
      - name: lifecycle_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lifecycle stage derived from customer_age_days, activity_status, retention_category, and cp.total_revenue vs cp average per defined precedence
      - name: activity_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Recency-based activity: ≤30 Highly Active; ≤90 Active; ≤180 At Risk; ≤365 Dormant; else Lost based on days_since_last_transaction'
      - name: retention_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tenure-based retention: ≥365 Long-term; ≥180 Medium-term; ≥90 Short-term; ≥30 New; else Very New based on customer_lifespan_days'
      - name: total_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total revenue from cp; final rows require total_revenue > 0; units as defined in cp (no conversion here)
      - name: net_profit
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Net profit from cp; no additional adjustments applied
      - name: transaction_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total transaction count from cp; may differ from cbp total_transactions; no distinct logic applied here
      - name: avg_transactions_per_month
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Average transactions per 30-day month from cbp: total_transactions/(customer_lifespan_days/30.0) when active_months>0 and lifespan>0 else 0 (no rounding)'
      - name: comprehensive_customer_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Composite score capped at 100 from weighted cp scores plus activity and retention bonuses per defined mapping
      - name: retention_probability
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,2)
        description: 'Predicted retention probability from discrete thresholds: 0.95/0.80/0.60/0.30/0.10/0.05 per recency and total_transactions'
      - name: seasonal_preference
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Quarter with highest distinct transaction count: ''Qx Peak'' with tie-breaker order Q1>Q2>Q3>Q4; else ''No Clear Pattern'''
      - name: transaction_consistency
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Volatility classification: NULL or 0→Single Transaction; ≤0.3x avg Very Consistent; ≤0.6x Consistent; ≤1.0x Moderate Variance; else High Variance'
      - name: growth_potential
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Growth outlook from lifecycle_stage, value_tier, activity_status, and score: High Growth Potential, Expansion Ready, Loyalty Program Candidate, Recovery Priority, or Standard Growth'
      - name: recommended_action
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Action recommendation precedence: Win-Back Campaign, Retention Campaign, Onboarding Support, Upsell Opportunity, VIP Treatment, else Regular Engagement'
      - name: engagement_frequency
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Suggested touch cadence: Platinum Weekly; Gold Bi-weekly; Silver Monthly; if lifecycle_stage=At Risk then Immediate; else Quarterly'
      - name: customer_age_days
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Days since customer creation from cp; integer day count
      - name: segmentation_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Build date set to current_date for all rows in the run
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: transaction_value_volatility
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sample standard deviation of positive Income converted_amounts per customer from cbp; NULL if insufficient data
      - name: q1_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct Income transaction_id count in calendar Q1 from cbp; non-negative integer
      - name: q2_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct Income transaction_id count in calendar Q2 from cbp; non-negative integer

      - name: q4_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct Income transaction_id count in calendar Q4 from cbp; non-negative integer
      - name: customer_analytics_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Deterministic hash of customer_id and segmentation_date joined by an underscore

        - not_null

      description: Executive financial dashboard aggregating ratios, cash flow, AR, customer metrics, trends, risk and benchmarks per subsidiary-period
      grain: One row per subsidiary_id and accounting_period_id present in intermediate.int_netsuite2__financial_ratios
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__financial_ratios
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__cash_flow_analysis
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__ar_aging_analysis
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__customer_profitability
      business_logic: '- Base rows come from intermediate.int_netsuite2__financial_ratios (fr); dashboard_date is set to the current_date at execution for all rows. - Left join cash_flow_analysis (cf) by subsidiary_id, filtering to the previous calendar month (the month of current_date minus one month); bring net_cash_flow, operating_cash_flow, cash_flow_health, predicted_next_month_cash_flow, cash_flow_risk_level. If no prior-month CF row exists for the subsidiary, CF outputs are NULL. - Left join AR aging (ar) by subsidiary_id, aggregating across all ar rows per subsidiary: - total_ar_amount and overdue_amount are summed across rows (ignoring NULLs). - overdue_percentage is the ratio of total overdue amount to total AR amount when total AR > 0; otherwise 0. If no AR rows exist for the subsidiary, all AR outputs are NULL. - weighted_average_days_outstanding is the simple average across rows (ignoring NULLs). - Left join customer profitability (cp_summary) by subsidiary_id, aggregating across all cp rows per subsidiary: - total_customers is the row count. - high_value_customers counts rows where customer_segment is Champion or Loyal. - at_risk_customers counts rows where customer_segment is At Risk or activity_status is At Risk. - total_customer_revenue is the sum of total_revenue (ignoring NULLs); average_customer_value is the average of total_revenue (ignoring NULLs). - No de-duplication; if no cp rows for the subsidiary, cp outputs are NULL. - Compute trends (ft) by aggregating financial_kpis per subsidiary_id: - avg_financial_health is the average of overall_financial_health_score; financial_health_volatility is its standard deviation. - avg_net_margin is the average of net_profit_margin; avg_current_ratio is the average of current_ratio. - positive_cash_flow_periods counts rows with cash_flow_health in Excellent or Good; total_periods counts all rows. - Compute risk assessment (ra) per subsidiary_id: - total_risk_score is the sum of four components: - overall_financial_health_score: <40 → 30; <60 → 20; <80 → 10; else 5. - cash_flow_risk_level: High Risk - Negative Trend → 25; contains High Risk → 20; contains Medium Risk → 10; else 5. - overdue_percentage: >0.30 → 20; >0.20 → 15; >0.10 → 10; else 5. - current_ratio: <1.0 → 25; <1.5 → 15; <2.0 → 10; else 5. - When any compared input is NULL, the corresponding component contributes 5. - risk_level buckets: total_risk_score ≥70 → Critical Risk; ≥50 → High Risk; ≥30 → Medium Risk; else Low Risk. - primary_risk_factor priority: overall_financial_health_score<40 → Poor Financial Health; cash_flow_risk_level contains High Risk → Cash Flow Issues; overdue_percentage>0.30 → High Receivables Risk; current_ratio<1.0 → Liquidity Concerns; else No Major Risk Factors. - Compute performance benchmarks (pb) per subsidiary_id: - liquidity_performance from current_ratio: ≥2.0 → Above Target; ≥1.5 → At Target; else Below Target. - profitability_performance from net_profit_margin: ≥0.15 → Above Target; ≥0.05 → At Target; else Below Target. - roe_performance from return_on_equity: ≥0.15 → Above Target; ≥0.10 → At Target; else Below Target. - collection_performance from overdue_percentage: ≤0.05 → Above Target; ≤0.15 → At Target; else Below Target. - improvement_recommendation priority: - If current_ratio<1.5 and net_profit_margin<0.05 → Focus on Operations & Liquidity; - Else if current_ratio<1.5 → Improve Working Capital Management; - Else if net_profit_margin<0.05 → Review Cost Structure; - Else if overdue_percentage>0.15 → Strengthen Collections; - Else → Maintain Current Performance. - Final output: - Select fk.* plus ft, ra, pb by subsidiary_id; filter out rows with NULL subsidiary_id. - cash_flow_consistency_percentage = (positive_cash_flow_periods / total_periods) × 100, rounded to 1 decimal; if total_periods=0, set to 0. - overall_rating, in order: overall_financial_health_score≥80 and risk_level=Low Risk → A+ Excellent; ≥70 and risk_level in Low/Medium Risk → A Good; ≥60 and risk_level≠Critical Risk → B Fair; ≥40 → C Poor; else → D Critical. - key_alert, first match wins: risk_level=Critical Risk → URGENT: Multiple Critical Risk Factors; cash_flow_risk_level contains High Risk → WARNING: Cash Flow Issues; current_ratio<1.0 → ALERT: Liquidity Below Safe Levels; overdue_percentage>0.30 → CAUTION: High Receivables Risk; else → Normal Operations. - dashboard_id is the MD5 hash of the string formed by subsidiary_id, a single underscore, and dashboard_date; casing and spacing are preserved. - Result ordering: descending by total_risk_score, then descending by overall_financial_health_score.'

    - name: netsuite2_operational_metrics
      description: Department/location monthly operational KPIs with trends, benchmarking, alerts, and recommendations derived from Netsuite transactions
      grain: One row per subsidiary_id, department_id, location_id, performance_month; if multiple class_id exist for the same keys, rows are duplicated (class_id is part of the internal grouping but not exposed)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_details
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__departments
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__locations
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__classes
      business_logic: '- Filter transactions to the last 24 months by accounting_period_ending. - Join transactions to transaction lines on transaction_line_id; left join departments, locations, and classes for display names. - Group by subsidiary_id, department_id, location_id, class_id, the month start of accounting_period_ending (performance_month), and the quarter; compute: - department_revenue: sum of converted_amount where account type is Income; 0 if none. - department_cogs: sum of absolute converted_amount where account type is COGS; non-negative. - department_expenses: sum of absolute converted_amount where account type is Expense; non-negative. - transaction_count: count of distinct transaction_id. - revenue_transactions: count of distinct transaction_id where account type is Income. - expense_transactions: count of distinct transaction_id where account type is COGS or Expense. - unique_entities_involved: count of distinct tl.entity_id. - analysis_date: current_date. - Derive operational efficiency per grouped row: - revenue_to_expense_ratio: revenue divided by expenses when expenses > 0; otherwise NULL. - gross_profit: revenue minus cogs. - gross_margin_percentage: (revenue minus cogs) divided by revenue when revenue > 0; otherwise 0. - net_profit: revenue minus cogs minus expenses. - net_margin_percentage: net_profit divided by revenue when revenue > 0; otherwise 0. - Additional intermediates (not selected later): average revenue per revenue transaction, average expense per expense transaction, and revenue per unique entity. - Compute trends per (subsidiary_id, department_id) using rows ordered by performance_month: - prev_month_revenue: value from the previous row in this order. - same_month_last_year_revenue: value from 12 rows prior in this order. - three_month_avg_revenue: average of the current row and the two immediately preceding rows (uses available rows when fewer than three). - three_month_avg_margin: same three-row window for gross_margin_percentage. - Note: because multiple location/class rows can exist for the same month, these windows operate over rows, not unique months; ties within a month use the engine’s row order. - Compute performance analysis: - month_over_month_growth: percentage change versus prev_month_revenue; rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when prev_month_revenue <= 0 or missing. - year_over_year_growth: percentage change versus the revenue 12 rows prior; rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when that prior value <= 0 or missing. - revenue_trend: ''Accelerating'' if revenue > 110% of the three-row average; ''Stable'' if > 90%; ''Declining'' if > 80%; else ''Sharp Decline''. - margin_trend: ''Improving'' if margin > 105% of the three-row average; ''Stable'' if > 95%; else ''Declining''. - performance_grade: ''Excellent'' when net margin >= 0.2 and ratio >= 2.0; ''Good'' when >= 0.1 and >= 1.5; ''Fair'' when >= 0.05 and >= 1.2; ''Poor'' when > 0; else ''Loss Making''. - Benchmark within each (subsidiary_id, performance_month): - revenue_rank_within_company: ranking by department_revenue descending; ties share rank with gaps. - margin_rank_within_company: ranking by net_margin_percentage descending; ties share rank with gaps. - revenue_vs_company_avg: revenue divided by the partition average revenue. - margin_vs_company_avg: net_margin_percentage minus the partition average net margin. - internal_market_share: revenue divided by the partition total revenue. - Alerts and recommendations (first matching condition applies): - alert_status: ''Revenue Decline Alert'' when year_over_year_growth < -20; else ''Loss Alert'' when net_margin_percentage < 0 and month_over_month_growth < -10; else ''Efficiency Alert'' when revenue_to_expense_ratio < 1.0; else ''Margin Alert'' when gross_margin_percentage < 0.1; else ''Normal''. NULL comparisons do not trigger alerts. - improvement_recommendation: ''Urgent restructuring required'' for ''Loss Making''; ''Review operations and cost structure'' for ''Poor'' with revenue_trend=''Declining''; ''Focus on cost optimization'' for margin_trend=''Declining'' with revenue_trend=''Stable''; ''Increase sales and marketing efforts'' for revenue_trend=''Declining'' with margin_trend=''Stable''; ''Scale successful practices'' for ''Good'' or ''Excellent''; else ''Monitor performance closely''. - investment_recommendation: ''Increase Investment'' for ''Excellent'' with ''Accelerating'' revenue; ''Growth Investment'' for ''Good'' or ''Excellent'' when internal_market_share < 0.3; ''Selective Investment'' for ''Fair'' with ''Improving'' margin; ''Review Investment'' for ''Poor'' or ''Loss Making''; else ''Maintain Current Investment''. - Final filter: keep only rows with performance_month in the last 12 months and non-NULL department_revenue. - Output order does not affect values: sort by subsidiary_id, performance_month descending, then department_revenue descending. - operational_metrics_id is an MD5 of subsidiary_id, department_id, and performance_month concatenated; any NULL input yields NULL.'
      columns:
      - name: subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        constraints:
        - not_null
        description: Subsidiary identifier sourced from transactions; grouping key used for window partitions and benchmarking
      - name: department_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Department identifier from transaction lines; may be NULL; used for grouping and window partitions
      - name: department_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Department display name from the departments table; NULL if no match; original casing and spacing preserved
      - name: location_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Location identifier from transaction lines; included in grouping; may be NULL
      - name: location_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Location display name from the locations table; NULL if no match; original casing and spacing preserved
      - name: performance_month
        data_type: DATE
        constraints:
        - not_null
        description: Month start date from accounting_period_ending; only the last 12 months are kept in the final result
      - name: department_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of converted_amount for Income lines per group; sign preserved; 0 when no Income lines exist
      - name: gross_profit
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Revenue minus COGS where COGS is the sum of absolute amounts for COGS lines
      - name: net_profit
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Revenue minus COGS minus Expenses where Expenses is the sum of absolute amounts for Expense lines
      - name: gross_margin_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Gross margin ratio equals (revenue minus COGS) divided by revenue when revenue > 0, otherwise 0; unitless and can be negative
      - name: net_margin_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Net margin ratio equals net_profit divided by revenue when revenue > 0, otherwise 0; unitless and can be negative
      - name: revenue_to_expense_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Revenue divided by expenses when expenses > 0, otherwise NULL; unrounded
      - name: month_over_month_growth
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change versus the previous row’s revenue within the same subsidiary and department; rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when the previous value <= 0 or missing
      - name: year_over_year_growth
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change versus the revenue 12 rows prior within the same subsidiary and department; rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when that prior value <= 0 or missing
      - name: three_month_avg_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Moving average over the current row and the two preceding rows ordered by performance_month; unrounded; may include duplicate months
      - name: revenue_trend
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Trend bucket comparing revenue to the three-row moving average: Accelerating, Stable, Declining, or Sharp Decline'
      - name: margin_trend
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Trend bucket comparing gross margin to the three-row moving average: Improving, Stable, or Declining'
      - name: performance_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Grade based on net margin and revenue-to-expense ratio with defined thresholds: Excellent, Good, Fair, Poor, or Loss Making'
      - name: revenue_rank_within_company
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Rank within (subsidiary_id, performance_month) by department_revenue descending; 1 is highest; ties share rank with gaps
      - name: margin_rank_within_company
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Rank within (subsidiary_id, performance_month) by net_margin_percentage descending; 1 is highest; ties share rank with gaps
      - name: revenue_vs_company_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Department revenue divided by the partition average revenue within (subsidiary_id, performance_month)
      - name: margin_vs_company_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Net margin minus the partition average net margin within (subsidiary_id, performance_month); unitless
      - name: internal_market_share
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Department revenue divided by the partition total revenue within (subsidiary_id, performance_month)
      - name: alert_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Alert based on ordered rules: Revenue Decline Alert, Loss Alert, Efficiency Alert, Margin Alert, else Normal; NULL comparisons do not trigger alerts'
      - name: improvement_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Recommendation derived from performance_grade and trend combinations; first matching rule determines the output
      - name: investment_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Investment guidance based on performance_grade, revenue_trend, and internal_market_share; first matching rule determines the output
      - name: analysis_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: current_date at model run time; identical across all rows in a run
      - name: operational_metrics_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: MD5 of subsidiary_id, department_id, and performance_month concatenated with underscores; NULL if any component is NULL; may repeat across locations or classes
    - name: netsuite2_vendor_risk_analysis
      description: Vendor risk analysis per vendor-subsidiary using transaction details, lines, and transactions to compute spend, payables, delays, dependency, risk scoring, and recommendations
      grain: One row per vendor_id and subsidiary_id (filtered to vendor_id IS NOT NULL and total_vendor_spend > 0)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_details
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transactions
      business_logic: '- Build vendor_transactions: - Join transaction_details to transaction_lines on transaction_line_id (inner), then to transactions on transaction_id (left). - Keep rows where vendor_id (from transaction_lines.entity_id) is present and account_type_name is one of AcctPay, Expense, or COGS. - Derive vendor fields: vendor_name is "Vendor_" plus the first 8 characters of vendor_id; vendor_email is "vendor_" plus the first 8 characters of vendor_id and the domain "@vendor.com"; vendor_category_name is "General Supplier"; carry subsidiary_id from transaction_details. - Transaction/date fields: transaction_date from transactions; due_date from transactions; analysis_month is the month of accounting_period_ending. - Payment metrics per line: days_from_due_date is the day difference between the due date and today (use transaction_date when due date is missing; positive means overdue, negatives allowed); payable_amount is the absolute amount only for AcctPay with negative converted_amount, else 0; expense_amount is the absolute amount only for Expense or COGS, else 0. - Aggregate vendor_financial_metrics grouped by vendor_id, vendor_name, vendor_email, vendor_category_name, subsidiary_id: - total_transactions is the count of distinct transaction_id. - active_months is the count of distinct analysis_month. - total_payables is the sum of payable_amount; total_expenses is the sum of expense_amount; total_vendor_spend is the sum of payable_amount plus expense_amount. - avg_payable_amount is the average of payable_amount over lines with payable_amount > 0 (NULL if none). - max_transaction_amount is the maximum of payable_amount plus expense_amount. - first_transaction_date is the earliest transaction_date; last_transaction_date is the latest transaction_date. - vendor_relationship_days is the day difference between first and last transaction_date (NULL if either date is NULL). - avg_payment_delay is the average days_from_due_date over lines with payable_amount > 0 (negatives possible; NULL if none). - overdue_invoices counts lines where payable_amount > 0 and days_from_due_date > 0; total_payable_invoices counts lines where payable_amount > 0. - days_since_last_transaction is the day difference between last_transaction_date and today (NULL if last_transaction_date is NULL). - analysis_date is set to today. - Compute vendor_dependency_analysis: - dependency_level uses total_vendor_spend compared to percentile thresholds of total_vendor_spend across all vendors: ≥90th → Critical Dependency; ≥70th → High Dependency; ≥50th → Medium Dependency; ≥30th → Low Dependency; otherwise Minimal Dependency. - overdue_payment_percentage is ((overdue_invoices / total_payable_invoices) × 100) rounded to 2 decimals; if total_payable_invoices = 0 then 0. - spend_concentration_ratio is total_vendor_spend divided by the total vendor spend within the same subsidiary_id; result is NULL when subsidiary_id is NULL. - relationship_stability: Very Stable if relationship_days ≥ 730 and active_months ≥ 12; Stable if ≥ 365 and ≥ 6; Developing if ≥ 180 and ≥ 3; New Relationship if ≥ 90; otherwise Very New. - activity_status: Active if days_since_last_transaction ≤ 30; Recent if ≤ 90; Inactive if ≤ 180; otherwise Dormant. - Compute vendor_risk_scoring: - vendor_risk_score is the sum of points: dependency_level (Critical 30, High 20, Medium 10, else 5) + overdue_payment_percentage (≥50 → 25, ≥30 → 20, ≥15 → 15, >0 → 10, else 0) + spend_concentration_ratio (≥0.2 → 25, ≥0.1 → 15, ≥0.05 → 10, else 5) + activity_status (Dormant 20, Inactive 15, Recent 5, Active 0). - business_impact_level: High Business Impact if dependency is Critical/High and concentration ≥ 0.1; Medium Business Impact if dependency is Medium and total_vendor_spend ≥ 10,000; Low Business Impact if total_vendor_spend ≥ 5,000; otherwise Minimal Business Impact. - supplier_tier: Strategic Partner if dependency is Critical and relationship is Very Stable/Stable; Key Supplier if dependency is High or Critical; Important Supplier if Medium; Regular Supplier if Low; otherwise Occasional Supplier. - management_priority: Urgent if dependency is Critical and overdue_payment_percentage > 20; High Priority if dependency is Critical/High; Medium Priority if dependency is Medium and overdue_payment_percentage > 0; Payment Focus if overdue_payment_percentage > 30; otherwise Standard Management. - Compute vendor_recommendations: - risk_level by vendor_risk_score: ≥70 High Risk; ≥50 Medium Risk; ≥30 Low Risk; otherwise Minimal Risk. - recommended_action: if vendor_risk_score ≥ 70 and dependency is Critical then Diversify supplier base urgently; else if vendor_risk_score ≥ 70 then Review vendor relationship and payment terms; else if dependency is Critical and overdue_payment_percentage > 0 then Prioritize payment processing; else if spend_concentration_ratio ≥ 0.2 then Consider supplier diversification; else if overdue_payment_percentage ≥ 30 then Improve payment processing; else if activity_status is Dormant and total_vendor_spend > 0 then Review vendor status; otherwise Maintain current relationship. - contract_recommendation by supplier_tier: Strategic Partner → Long-term strategic contract with SLA; Key Supplier → Multi-year contract with performance metrics; Important Supplier → Annual contract with review clause; otherwise Standard purchase agreement. - payment_recommendation: if overdue_payment_percentage > 50 then Immediate payment processing review; else if > 20 then Expedite payment processing; else if supplier_tier is Strategic Partner then Consider early payment discounts; otherwise Standard payment terms. - Final output: - Keep rows where vendor_id is not null and total_vendor_spend > 0. - Compute vendor_risk_analysis_id as the MD5 hash of the string "vendor_id_subsidiary_id_analysis_date" (components joined with underscores); result is NULL if any component is NULL. - Order rows by vendor_risk_score descending, then total_vendor_spend descending.'
      columns:
      - name: vendor_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        constraints:
        - not_null
        description: Vendor identifier from transaction_lines.entity_id; primary grouping key
      - name: vendor_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Text label 'Vendor_' plus the first 8 characters of vendor_id
      - name: vendor_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Email 'vendor_' plus the first 8 characters of vendor_id and '@vendor.com'
      - name: vendor_category_name

      - name: avg_payable_amount

      - name: max_transaction_amount

      - name: vendor_relationship_days

      - name: avg_payment_delay

        description: Average days since due date over payable lines; negatives allowed; NULL if no payable lines
      - name: overdue_payment_percentage

        description: Percentage of overdue payable lines rounded to 2 decimals; set to 0 when there are no payable lines
      - name: overdue_invoices

      - name: total_payable_invoices

      - name: dependency_level

      - name: spend_concentration_ratio

      - name: relationship_stability

      - name: activity_status
        data_type: VARCHAR

      - name: vendor_risk_score

      - name: risk_level

      - name: business_impact_level

      - name: supplier_tier

      - name: management_priority

      - name: recommended_action

      - name: contract_recommendation

      - name: payment_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Payment guidance based on overdue_payment_percentage and supplier_tier
      - name: first_transaction_date

        description: Earliest transaction_date per vendor-subsidiary
      - name: last_transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Latest transaction_date per vendor-subsidiary
      - name: days_since_last_transaction

        description: Days between last_transaction_date and today; NULL if last_transaction_date is NULL
      - name: analysis_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Run date (today) for the analysis; identical across rows within a run
      - name: vendor_risk_analysis_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: MD5 hash of vendor_id, subsidiary_id, and analysis_date joined by underscores; NULL if any component is NULL
    - name: netsuite2_transaction_details_original
      description: Original Netsuite transaction line details assembled from core line records joined to related dimensions; includes sign-adjusted amounts and a surrogate key
      grain: One row per transaction_line_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transactions
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__tran_with_converted_amounts
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounts
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounting_periods
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__customers
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__items
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__locations
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__vendors
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__vendor_categories
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__departments
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__currencies
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__subsidiaries
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__classes
      business_logic: 'Build one row per transaction_lines.transaction_line_id: - Start from transaction lines; inner join transactions by transaction_id; inner join subsidiaries by subsidiary_id from the line. - Left join: - Converted amounts on matching transaction_line_id and transaction_id, keeping rows where transaction_accounting_period_id equals reporting_accounting_period_id. - Accounts by line.account_id; and parent account by accounts.parent_id (treated as text). - Accounting periods by transactions.accounting_period_id. - Customers twice: transaction-side by transactions.entity_id; line-side by line.entity_id. - Classes by line.class_id; items by line.item_id; locations by line.location_id. - Vendors twice: transaction-side by transactions.entity_id; line-side by line.entity_id. - Vendor categories twice: from each joined vendor’s vendor_category_id. - Departments by line.department_id. - Currencies twice: transaction currency by transactions.currency_id; subsidiary currency by subsidiaries.currency_id. - Deterministic rules: - entity_id takes the line entity_id when present; otherwise the transaction entity_id. - is_transaction_non_posting is the opposite of line.is_posting; remains NULL when is_posting is NULL. - Accounting period fields come from the joined accounting period; transaction_due_date comes from transactions.due_date_at. - Account flags: - is_accounts_payable is true when account_type_name equals ''acctpay'' ignoring case; is_accounts_receivable is true when it equals ''acctrec'' ignoring case. - is_expense_account is true when account_type_name is one of ''expense'',''othexpense'',''deferexpense'' ignoring case; is_income_account is true when it is ''income'' or ''othincome'' ignoring case. - If account_type_name is NULL, these flags are NULL. - parent_account_id/name use the parent account when available; otherwise fall back to the current account id/name. - is_account_intercompany and is_eliminate are always false. - Customer fields (id/alt_name/company_name/city/state/zipcode/country/date_first_order/customer_external_id) are taken from the transaction-side customer when transaction_type is ''custinvc'' or ''custcred'' ignoring case; otherwise from the line-side customer. If transaction_type is NULL, use the line-side. - Vendor fields (vendor_category_id/name, vendor_id/alt_name/vendor_name/vendor_create_date) are taken from the transaction-side vendor and its category when transaction_type is ''vendbill'' or ''vendcred'' ignoring case; otherwise from the line-side vendor and its category. If transaction_type is NULL, use the line-side. - Location fields come from the joined location; transaction currency fields come from the joined transaction currency; subsidiary_currency_symbol comes from the joined subsidiary currency; department fields come from the joined department; class fields from the joined class; item fields and sales_description from the joined item. - Amounts: - converted_amount is the converted amount using the transaction’s accounting period; its sign is flipped when the account type is ''income'' or ''othincome'' ignoring case; otherwise the sign is unchanged. If the converted amount row is missing, the value is NULL. - transaction_amount and transaction_line_amount follow the same sign inversion rule above, applied to line.amount and line.netamount respectively. If account_type_name is NULL, no inversion is applied. - transaction_details_id is the MD5 hash of transaction_line_id and transaction_id concatenated with an underscore; inputs are treated as text; NULL when either input is NULL. - All rows from the joins are retained; NULLs from left joins are preserved; no explicit ordering is applied.'
      columns:
      - name: transaction_line_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        constraints:
        - not_null
        description: Primary line key from transaction_lines.transaction_line_id; one output row per value
      - name: transaction_memo
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Line memo from transaction_lines.memo; NULLs preserved
      - name: is_transaction_non_posting
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Opposite of transaction_lines.is_posting; NULL when is_posting is NULL
      - name: is_main_line
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Flag from transaction_lines.is_main_line; NULLs preserved
      - name: is_tax_line
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Flag from transaction_lines.is_tax_line; NULLs preserved
