    - name: netsuite__balance_sheet
      description: Balance sheet view built from transaction lines with period-aware currency conversion, account mapping, and a synthetic CTA row
      grain: One row per transaction_line_id per reporting accounting_period_id per output account_name (includes synthetic CTA rows)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__tran_with_converted_amounts
      - staging.stg_netsuite__accounts
      - staging.stg_netsuite__accounting_periods
      - staging.stg_netsuite__subsidiaries
      business_logic: 'Inputs - transactions_with_converted_amounts: precomputed transaction-level amounts including converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period and converted_amount_using_reporting_month, plus transaction_id, transaction_line_id, account_id, account_category, reporting_accounting_period_id, transaction_accounting_period_id, is_income_statement. - accounts: account metadata including account_id, name, type_name, account_number, is_balancesheet, is_leftside, general_rate_type. - accounting_periods: accounting period attributes including accounting_period_id, name, full_name, ending_at, is_adjustment, is_closed, year_id, fiscal_calendar_id. - subsidiaries: used only to select the fiscal_calendar_id of the top-level parent subsidiary (row with parent_id IS NULL). Steps 1) Join accounts to transactions on account_id (IDs compared as strings). 2) Join reporting_accounting_periods by reporting_accounting_period_id and transaction_accounting_periods by transaction_accounting_period_id (IDs compared as strings). 3) Restrict to periods in the top-level fiscal calendar: - reporting_accounting_periods.fiscal_calendar_id must equal the fiscal_calendar_id of the parentless subsidiary. - transaction_accounting_periods.fiscal_calendar_id must also equal that same fiscal_calendar_id (base rows only). 4) Keep rows where either the account is a balance sheet account (is_balancesheet equals true, case-insensitive ''t'') or the transaction is flagged is_income_statement = true. 5) Produce base balance sheet rows: - Period fields come from reporting_accounting_periods. - account_name and account_type_name: - If account is not a balance sheet account: - If reporting and transaction accounting periods are in the same fiscal year → "Net Income" - Else → "Retained Earnings" - Otherwise use accounts.name / accounts.type_name. - account_id and account_number are NULL for non-balance-sheet accounts; otherwise taken from accounts (account_id represented as a string). - converted_amount selection (all string comparisons case-insensitive): - If non-balance-sheet account and general_rate_type in {historical, average}: → negative of converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period - Else if non-balance-sheet account: → negative of converted_amount_using_reporting_month - Else if balance-sheet account and is_leftside = false and general_rate_type in {historical, average}: → negative of converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period - Else if balance-sheet account and is_leftside = true and general_rate_type in {historical, average}: → converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period - Else if balance-sheet account and is_leftside = false: → negative of converted_amount_using_reporting_month - Else if balance-sheet account and is_leftside = true: → converted_amount_using_reporting_month - Else → 0. Note: If the chosen source amount is NULL, the result is NULL; the literal 0 applies only when no predicate matched. - balance_sheet_sort_helper (case-insensitive on accounts.type_name): bank→1; accounts receivable→2; unbilled receivable→3; other current asset→4; fixed asset→5; other asset→6; deferred expense→7; accounts payable→8; credit card→9; other current liability→10; long term liability→11; deferred revenue→12; equity→13; non-balance-sheet with same year (Net Income)→15; other non-balance-sheet (Retained Earnings)→14; else NULL. 6) Union ALL a synthetic CTA row for each qualifying transaction line and reporting period: - account_category = ''Equity''; account_name = ''Cumulative Translation Adjustment''; account_type_name = ''Cumulative Translation Adjustment''; account_id = NULL; account_number = NULL. - converted_amount: - If the transaction''s account_category is ''equity'' (case-insensitive) OR is_income_statement = true: → converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period - Else → converted_amount_using_reporting_month. - balance_sheet_sort_helper = 16. - Join only reporting_accounting_periods and apply the same reporting fiscal calendar filter and the same inclusion filter (account is balance sheet OR is_income_statement). No transaction-period calendar filter here. 7) Booleans is_accounting_period_adjustment and is_accounting_period_closed are true only when the corresponding period flag equals "yes" (case-insensitive), false otherwise, and NULL when the source flag is NULL. 8) No aggregation or deduplication is performed; UNION ALL preserves duplicates across scenarios.'
      columns:
      - name: transaction_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source transaction identifier from int_netsuite2__tran_with_converted_amounts; duplicates allowed across rows
      - name: transaction_line_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source transaction line identifier; may appear twice per period when a CTA row is generated
      - name: accounting_period_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Reporting accounting period identifier from stg_netsuite__accounting_periods
      - name: accounting_period_ending
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reporting period end from accounting_periods.ending_at as stored
      - name: accounting_period_full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reporting period full_name from stg_netsuite__accounting_periods
      - name: accounting_period_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reporting period short name from stg_netsuite__accounting_periods
      - name: is_accounting_period_adjustment
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True only when reporting period adjustment flag equals 'yes' (case-insensitive); NULL when source is NULL; false otherwise
      - name: is_accounting_period_closed
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True only when reporting period closed flag equals 'yes' (case-insensitive); NULL when source is NULL; false otherwise
      - name: account_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'For base rows: passthrough from transactions; for CTA rows: literal ''Equity'''
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Base rows: account name or remapped to ''Net Income''/''Retained Earnings'' for non-BS accounts; CTA rows: ''Cumulative Translation Adjustment'''
      - name: account_type_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Base rows: account type or remapped to ''Net Income''/''Retained Earnings'' for non-BS accounts; CTA rows: ''Cumulative Translation Adjustment'''
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: accounts.account_id (as string) for balance-sheet accounts; NULL for non-balance-sheet and CTA rows
      - name: account_number
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: accounts.account_number for balance-sheet accounts; NULL for non-balance-sheet and CTA rows
      - name: converted_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Signed converted amount selected from precomputed fields per deterministic rules (BS vs non-BS, left/right side, rate type, CTA logic); if chosen source is NULL the result is NULL; 0 only when no condition matched
      - name: balance_sheet_sort_helper
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Deterministic sort key: types map to 1–13; non-BS: Retained Earnings=14, Net Income=15; CTA=16; NULL otherwise'

      grain: One row per (transaction_id, transaction_line_id)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__tran_with_converted_amounts
      - staging.stg_netsuite__transaction_lines
      - staging.stg_netsuite__accounts
      - staging.stg_netsuite__accounting_periods

      - staging.stg_netsuite__locations
      - staging.stg_netsuite__departments
      business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_netsuite2__tran_with_converted_amounts (includes transaction_id, transaction_line_id, account_id, subsidiary_id, reporting_accounting_period_id, transaction_accounting_period_id, converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period, is_income_statement, account_category). - Inner join transaction_lines on both transaction_id and transaction_line_id to obtain class_id, location_id, and department_id. - Left join classes, locations, and departments using those IDs to bring in their full_name attributes; missing IDs yield NULL full_name values. - Inner join accounts on account_id to bring account name, type, number, and to build the combined label. - Inner join accounting_periods on reporting_accounting_period_id; filter to periods in the root fiscal calendar (the fiscal calendar of the subsidiary with no parent), and require transaction_accounting_period_id equals reporting_accounting_period_id. - Inner join subsidiaries on subsidiary_id. - Filter to rows where is_income_statement is true; class FixedNetSuiteDataPipeline:
    """Fixed version of the NetSuite data pipeline orchestrator"""
    
    def __init__(self, 
                 source_db_path: str = "netsuite_start.duckdb", 
                 target_db_path: str = "netsuite.duckdb",
                 config_path: str = "config/layer_dependencies.yaml"):
        self.source_db_path = source_db_path
        self.target_db_path = target_db_path
        self.config_path = config_path
        self.config = self._load_config()
        self.sql_dir = Path("sql")
        
                
        self.schema_config = {
            'raw': 'raw',
            'staging': 'staging',
            'intermediate': 'intermediate',
            'marts': 'mart'
        }
        
        self.conn = None
        
    def _load_config(self) -> dict:
        """Load the configuration file"""
        try:
            with open(self.config_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                return yaml.safe_load(f)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            logger.error(f"Configuration file {self.config_path} not found")
            raise
        except yaml.YAMLError as e:
            logger.error(f"Configuration file parsing error: {e}")
            raise
    
    def _create_schemas(self):
        """Create schemas for data layers (without cleaning existing data)"""
        logger.info("🏗️ Ensuring Schema layered architecture exists")
        
        for layer, schema_name in self.schema_config.items():
            try:
                self.conn.execute(f"CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS {schema_name}")
                logger.info(f"  ✓ Ensured schema exists: {schema_name}")
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"  ✗ Failed to create schema {schema_name}: {e}")
                raise
    
    def _load_sql_file(self, file_path: Path) -> str:
        """Load the content of an SQL file"""
        try:
            with open(file_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                return f.read()
        except FileNotFoundError:
            logger.error(f"SQL file {file_path} not found")
            raise
    
    def _attach_source_db_and_expose_raw(self):
        """
        Attach the source DuckDB and expose its raw.* tables as views in the current target database.
        This allows raw.* references in SQL to work directly.
        """
        import os
        try:
            
            attached = {row[1] for row in self.conn.execute("PRAGMA database_list").fetchall()}
            if 'source' not in attached:
                source_path = os.path.abspath(self.source_db_path)
                self.conn.execute(f"ATTACH '{source_path}' AS source (READ_ONLY)")
                logger.info(f"  ✓ Attached source database as 'source': {source_path}")
            else:
                logger.info("  ℹ️ Source database 'source' is already attached, skipping ATTACH")

            self.conn.execute("CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS raw")

            
            tables = self.conn.execute(
                "SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_catalog = 'source' AND table_schema = 'raw'"
            ).fetchall()
            for (table_name,) in tables:
                view_sql = f"CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW raw.{table_name} AS SELECT * FROM source.raw.{table_name}"
                self.conn.execute(view_sql)
            logger.info(f"  ✓ Exposed {len(tables)} source.raw.* tables as raw.* views")
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to attach source database or create raw views: {e}")
            raise

    def _execute_sql(self, sql: str, table_name: str, layer_name: str) -> bool:
        """Execute SQL and create a table in the specified schema"""
        try:
            
            target_schema = self.schema_config[layer_name]
            full_table_name = f"{target_schema}.{table_name}"
            
                        
            processed_sql = self._process_sql_references(sql, layer_name)
            
                        
            create_table_sql = f"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE {full_table_name} AS ({processed_sql})"
            
            logger.info(f"Executing: {full_table_name}")
            self.conn.execute(create_table_sql)
            
                        
            count_result = self.conn.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {full_table_name}").fetchone()
            row_count = count_result[0] if count_result else 0
            
            logger.info(f"✓ {full_table_name}: {row_count:,} rows")
            return True
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"✗ {full_table_name}: {e}")
            return False
    
    def _process_sql_references(self, sql: str, current_layer: str) -> str:
        """
        Keep schema qualifications in SQL unchanged. raw.* will be provided through views on the attached source database.
        """
        return sql
    
    def _execute_layer(self, layer_name: str) -> bool:
        """Execute all tables for a specified layer"""
        layer_config = self.config['layers'][layer_name]
        tables = layer_config.get('tables', [])
        
                
        execution_order = self.config.get('execution_order', {}).get(layer_name, tables)
        
        logger.info(f"\n=== Executing {layer_name.upper()} Layer ===")
        logger.info(f"Description: {layer_config.get('description', '')}")
        
        success_count = 0
        total_count = len(execution_order)
        
        for table_name in execution_order:
            
            sql_file_path = self.sql_dir / layer_name / f"{table_name}.sql"
            
            if not sql_file_path.exists():
                logger.warning(f"Skipping {table_name}: SQL file does not exist ({sql_file_path})")
                continue
            
            sql_content = self._load_sql_file(sql_file_path)
            if self._execute_sql(sql_content, table_name, layer_name):
                success_count += 1
        
        logger.info(f"{layer_name.upper()} layer complete: {success_count}/{total_count} tables created successfully")
        return success_count == total_count

    def run_pipeline(self, layers: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> bool:

        logger.info(f"Source database: {self.source_db_path}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Utility to execute a single SQL model against lever_start.duckdb (or a custom db).

This helps iterate on one SQL file without running the whole config-driven pipeline:

    python test_single_sql.py --table stg_lever__application --layer staging
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional, Tuple

import duckdb

SQL_ROOT = Path("sql")
INTERMEDIATE_SUBDIRS = ["opportunity", "contact", "interview", "posting", "requisition"]
LAYER_SCHEMAS = {
    "raw": "raw",
    "staging": "staging",
    "intermediate": "intermediate",
    "marts": "marts",
}
DB_PATH = Path("netsuite_start.duckdb")


def _candidate_paths(table: str, layer: Optional[str]) -> Tuple[Tuple[Path, str], ...]:
    """
    Build all possible SQL paths for a table, optionally restricting to a single layer.
    Returns tuples of (path, layer_name) in priority order.
    """
    search_layers = [layer] if layer else list(LAYER_SCHEMAS.keys())
    candidates = []

    for layer_name in search_layers:
        base = SQL_ROOT / layer_name / f"{table}.sql"
        candidates.append((base, layer_name))

        if layer_name == "intermediate":
            for subdir in INTERMEDIATE_SUBDIRS:
                candidates.append(
                    (SQL_ROOT / layer_name / subdir / f"{table}.sql", layer_name)
                )

    return tuple(candidates)

def locate_sql(table: str, layer: Optional[str]) -> Tuple[Path, str]:
    """Locate the SQL file for `table` and return (path, layer)."""
    for candidate, candidate_layer in _candidate_paths(table, layer):
        if candidate.exists():
            return candidate, candidate_layer
    searched = "\n  ".join(str(path) for path, _ in _candidate_paths(table, layer))
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        f"SQL file for {table} not found. Checked paths:\n  {searched}"
    )

def ensure_schema(conn: duckdb.DuckDBPyConnection, schema: str) -> None:
    conn.execute(f"CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS {schema}")


def execute_sql(
    conn: duckdb.DuckDBPyConnection,
    sql_text: str,
    schema: str,
    table: str,
) -> int:
    full_table_name = f"{schema}.{table}"
    conn.execute(f"DROP TABLE IF EXISTS {full_table_name}")
    conn.execute(f"CREATE TABLE {full_table_name} AS ({sql_text})")
    row_count = conn.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {full_table_name}").fetchone()[0]
    return row_count


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description=("Execute a single SQL model against lever_start.duckdb to validate logic without running the full pipeline.")
    )
    parser.add_argument("--table", required=True, help="Table/model name without .sql, e.g. stg_lever__application")
    parser.add_argument("--layer", choices=LAYER_SCHEMAS.keys(), help="Layer where the table lives; auto-detected when omitted")
    return parser.parse_args()

def main() -> int:
    args = parse_args()
    try:
        sql_path, layer = locate_sql(args.table, args.layer)
    except FileNotFoundError as exc:
        print(exc, file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    schema = LAYER_SCHEMAS[layer]
    if not DB_PATH.exists():
        print(f"DuckDB file not found: {DB_PATH}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    sql_text = sql_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    print(f"Connecting to database: {DB_PATH}")
    conn = duckdb.connect(str(DB_PATH))
    ensure_schema(conn, schema)

    print(f"Executing SQL: {sql_path} -> {schema}.{args.table}")
    row_count = execute_sql(conn, sql_text, schema, args.table)
    print(f"Done: {schema}.{args.table} contains {row_count} rows")

    conn.close()
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

WITH source_data AS (
    SELECT
    TRY_CAST(r."id" AS VARCHAR) AS customer_id,
    TRY_CAST(r."entityid" AS VARCHAR) AS entity_id,
    TRY_CAST(r."externalid" AS VARCHAR) AS customer_external_id,
    TRY_CAST(r."parent" AS VARCHAR) AS parent_id,
    CASE WHEN lower(trim(cast(r."isperson" AS VARCHAR))) IN ('true','t','1','yes','y') THEN TRUE WHEN lower(trim(cast(r."isperson" AS VARCHAR))) IN ('false','f','0','no','n') THEN FALSE ELSE TRY_CAST(r."isperson" AS BOOLEAN) END AS is_person,
    TRY_CAST(r."altname" AS VARCHAR) AS alt_name,
    TRY_CAST(r."companyname" AS VARCHAR) AS company_name,
    TRY_CAST(r."firstname" AS VARCHAR) AS first_name,
    TRY_CAST(r."lastname" AS VARCHAR) AS last_name,
    TRY_CAST(r."email" AS VARCHAR) AS email_address,
    TRY_CAST(r."phone" AS VARCHAR) AS phone_number,
    TRY_CAST(r."defaultbillingaddress" AS VARCHAR) AS default_billing_address_id,
    TRY_CAST(r."defaultshippingaddress" AS VARCHAR) AS default_shipping_address_id,
    TRY_CAST(r."receivablesaccount" AS VARCHAR) AS receivables_account_id,
    TRY_CAST(r."currency" AS VARCHAR) AS currency_id,
    TRY_CAST(r."firstorderdate" AS DATE) AS date_first_order_at
    FROM raw.netsuite2_customer_data r
), cleaned AS (
 SELECT *,
  CASE WHEN email_address IS NULL OR regexp_full_match(email_address, '[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\\.[A-Za-z](2,)') THEN lower(trim(email_address)) ELSE NULL END AS cleaned_email,
  CASE WHEN phone_number IS NULL OR (length(trim(phone_number)) BETWEEN 8 AND 20) THEN regexp_replace(trim(phone_number), '[^0-9+()-]', '') ELSE NULL END AS cleaned_phone
 FROM source_data
)
SELECT * EXCLUDE (email_address, phone_number, cleaned_email, cleaned_phone), cleaned_email AS email_address, cleaned_phone AS phone_number
FROM cleaned
WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL

WITH transaction_stats AS (
    SELECT
        'Transactions' AS table_name,
        count(*)::BIGINT AS total_records,
        count(DISTINCT transaction_id)::BIGINT AS unique_records,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE transaction_id IS NULL)::BIGINT AS null_primary_keys,
        min(transaction_date) AS earliest_value,
        max(transaction_date) AS latest_value,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE transaction_date IS NULL)::BIGINT AS null_dates,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE entity_id IS NULL)::BIGINT AS null_entities
    FROM staging.stg_netsuite2__transactions
), line_stats AS (
    SELECT
        'Transaction lines' AS table_name,
        count(*)::BIGINT AS total_records,
        count(DISTINCT transaction_line_id)::BIGINT AS unique_records,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE transaction_line_id IS NULL)::BIGINT AS null_primary_keys,
        min(transaction_id) AS earliest_value,
        max(transaction_id) AS latest_value,
        0::BIGINT AS null_dates,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE transaction_id IS NULL)::BIGINT AS null_entities
    FROM staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines
), customer_stats AS (
    SELECT
        'Customers' AS table_name,
        count(*)::BIGINT AS total_records,
        count(DISTINCT customer_id)::BIGINT AS unique_records,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE customer_id IS NULL)::BIGINT AS null_primary_keys,
        min(company_name) AS earliest_value,
        max(company_name) AS latest_value,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE company_name IS NULL)::BIGINT AS null_dates,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE email_address IS NULL)::BIGINT AS null_entities
    FROM staging.stg_netsuite2__customers
), table_stats AS (
    SELECT * FROM transaction_stats
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM line_stats
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM customer_stats
), integrity AS (
    SELECT 'transaction_lines_to_transactions' AS check_name,
           count(t.transaction_id)::BIGINT AS matched,
           count(*)::BIGINT AS total
    FROM staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines l
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_netsuite2__transactions t USING (transaction_id)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'transaction_lines_to_entities', count(e.entity_id)::BIGINT, count(*)::BIGINT
    FROM staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines l
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_netsuite2__entities e ON e.entity_id = l.entity_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'transactions_to_entities', count(e.entity_id)::BIGINT, count(*)::BIGINT
    FROM staging.stg_netsuite2__transactions t
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_netsuite2__entities e ON e.entity_id = t.entity_id
), assessment AS (
    SELECT
        avg(CASE
            WHEN table_name = 'Transactions' AND null_primary_keys + null_dates + null_entities = 0 THEN 100.0
            WHEN table_name = 'Customers' AND null_primary_keys + null_dates = 0 THEN 100.0
            WHEN table_name = 'Transaction lines' THEN 85.0
            ELSE 70.0
        END) AS completeness_score,
        (SELECT avg(round(100.0 * matched / nullif(total, 0), 2)) FROM integrity) AS consistency_score,
        100.0 AS accuracy_score,
        current_timestamp AS assessment_timestamp
    FROM table_stats
), report AS (
    SELECT
        'Data Quality Assessment'::VARCHAR AS report_type,
        completeness_score,
        consistency_score,
        accuracy_score,
        round((completeness_score + consistency_score + accuracy_score) / 3.0, 2) AS overall_quality_score,
        CASE WHEN (completeness_score + consistency_score + accuracy_score) / 3.0 >= 95 THEN 'Excellent'
             WHEN (completeness_score + consistency_score + accuracy_score) / 3.0 >= 85 THEN 'Good'
             WHEN (completeness_score + consistency_score + accuracy_score) / 3.0 >= 70 THEN 'Fair'
             WHEN (completeness_score + consistency_score + accuracy_score) / 3.0 >= 50 THEN 'Poor' ELSE 'Critical' END::VARCHAR AS quality_grade,
        CASE WHEN completeness_score < 80 THEN 'Data Completeness Issues'
             WHEN consistency_score < 80 THEN 'Referential Integrity Issues'
             WHEN accuracy_score < 80 THEN 'Business Rule Violations' ELSE 'No Major Issues' END::VARCHAR AS primary_concern,
        CASE WHEN (completeness_score + consistency_score + accuracy_score) / 3.0 < 70 THEN 'Immediate Data Cleansing Required'
             WHEN (completeness_score + consistency_score + accuracy_score) / 3.0 < 85 THEN 'Regular Data Quality Monitoring Recommended'
             ELSE 'Maintain Current Data Quality Standards' END::VARCHAR AS recommended_action,
        (SELECT count(*)::BIGINT FROM table_stats) AS tables_assessed,
        (SELECT count(*)::BIGINT FROM integrity) AS integrity_checks_performed,
        4::BIGINT AS business_rules_validated,
        assessment_timestamp,
        md5(cast(assessment_timestamp AS VARCHAR)) AS quality_assessment_id
    FROM assessment
), detail_stats AS (
    SELECT
        'Table Statistics'::VARCHAR AS report_type,
        NULL::DOUBLE AS completeness_score,
        NULL::DOUBLE AS consistency_score,
        NULL::DOUBLE AS accuracy_score,
        NULL::DOUBLE AS overall_quality_score,
        table_name::VARCHAR AS quality_grade,
        ('Records: ' || total_records || ', Unique: ' || unique_records || ', Null PKs: ' || null_primary_keys)::VARCHAR AS primary_concern,
        CASE WHEN table_name = 'Transactions' THEN 'Date Range: ' || earliest_value || ' to ' || latest_value
             WHEN table_name = 'Transaction lines' THEN 'Date Range: ' || earliest_value || ' to ' || latest_value
             ELSE 'Date Range: ' || null_dates || ' to ' || null_entities END::VARCHAR AS recommended_action,
        NULL::BIGINT AS tables_assessed,
        NULL::BIGINT AS integrity_checks_performed,
        NULL::BIGINT AS business_rules_validated,
        current_timestamp AS assessment_timestamp,
        md5(table_name || cast(current_timestamp AS VARCHAR)) AS quality_assessment_id
    FROM table_stats
), detail_integrity AS (
    SELECT
        'Integrity Checks'::VARCHAR AS report_type,
        NULL::DOUBLE AS completeness_score,
        NULL::DOUBLE AS consistency_score,
        NULL::DOUBLE AS accuracy_score,
        round(100.0 * matched / nullif(total, 0), 2) AS overall_quality_score,
        check_name::VARCHAR AS quality_grade,
        ('Matched: ' || matched || '/' || total)::VARCHAR AS primary_concern,
        ('Orphaned Records: ' || (total - matched))::VARCHAR AS recommended_action,
        NULL::BIGINT AS tables_assessed,
        NULL::BIGINT AS integrity_checks_performed,
        NULL::BIGINT AS business_rules_validated,
        current_timestamp AS assessment_timestamp,
        md5(check_name || cast(current_timestamp AS VARCHAR)) AS quality_assessment_id
    FROM integrity
)
SELECT * FROM report
UNION ALL SELECT * FROM detail_stats
UNION ALL SELECT * FROM detail_integrity
